items.title_en: Tutorial: Vision-Based Formation Control with Differential-Drive Robots
items.title_zh: 教程：基于视觉的差分驱动机器人编队控制
items.abstract_en: This tutorial presents a step-by-step introduction to multi-robot formation control using differential- drive robots, an overhead camera, and Python. ArUco markers are used to estimate robot positions and orientations, while desired pairwise displacement vectors define a circular formation. By comparing measured and desired relative positions, the controller computes movement vectors that are converted into differential-drive wheel commands, with basic proximity-sensor-based obstacle avoidance. The tutorial guides readers through hardware and software setup, robot pose estimation, formation geometry, feedback control, system integration, and formation-error evaluation. Motivated by the need to bridge the gap between theoretical understanding and practical implementation in robotics education, we emphasize how mathematical concepts are translated into coordinated behaviors on physical robots. Although the implementation uses a specific robotic platform, the underlying perception and formation-control principles can be adapted to other differential-drive robots and simulation environments. The accompanying open-source GitHub repository provides the Python implementation, setup instructions, and demonstrations to support hands-on learning and further exploration of multi-robot systems.
items.abstract_zh: 本教程以差分驱动机器人、顶置摄像头和 Python 为工具，逐步介绍多机器人编队控制的实现流程。系统利用 ArUco 标记估计各机器人的位置与朝向，并以期望的成对位移向量定义圆形编队。控制器通过比较实测与期望的相对位置，计算出运动向量并转换为差分驱动的轮速指令，同时结合简易的接近传感器避障。教程依次讲解硬件与软件搭建、机器人位姿估计、编队几何、反馈控制、系统集成以及编队误差评估。作者指出，机器人教育中理论理解与实际实现之间存在鸿沟，因此着重展示数学概念如何转化为实体机器人上的协同行为。虽然实现基于特定平台，但其感知与编队控制原理可迁移到其他差分驱动机器人及仿真环境。配套的开源 GitHub 仓库提供 Python 实现、搭建说明与演示，支持动手学习与进一步探索多机器人系统。
items.highlight_zh: 用顶置相机加 ArUco 标记，把编队控制理论落地为可复现的机器人教程
items.digest_zh:
这篇教程要解决的问题是：多机器人编队控制的理论（相对位置、反馈律、误差收敛）在课堂上讲得很清楚，但学生往往不知道怎样把它变成真实机器人上的协同动作。作者因此设计了一套从零到跑通的完整教学方案。

方法上，硬件是一组差分驱动小车，头顶架一台普通摄像头俯拍场地；地面上机器人顶部贴 ArUco 方形标记，视觉算法据此估计每个机器人的位置和朝向，相当于给系统提供全局“定位”。编队目标被定义为若干成对的期望位移向量，这些向量共同描述一个圆形队形。控制器把实测的相对位置与期望值相减得到误差，据此算出每个机器人应走的运动向量，再换算成左右轮的差分驱动指令；此外还叠加了基于接近传感器的简单避障，避免机器人相互碰撞。

结果方面，教程给出了从硬件软件环境配置、位姿估计、编队几何设定、反馈控制实现到系统集成与编队误差评估的完整链路，并通过演示验证机器人能够形成并保持目标队形。作者强调，虽然具体实现绑定了某一平台，但感知与编队控制的原理可迁移到其他差分驱动机器人和仿真环境中，配套开源仓库提供了代码与搭建说明。

为何重要：它把抽象的数学（向量误差、反馈增益、坐标变换）与真实机器人的协同行为直接对应起来，降低了多机器人系统的入门门槛，适合作为机器人教育与实验室教学的实操教材。

items.title_en: Real-Time Event-Based LED Tracking and Pose Estimation with PWM-Encoded Markers
items.title_zh: 基于PWM编码标记的实时事件相机LED跟踪与位姿估计
items.abstract_en: Event cameras are neuromorphic vision sensors with pixels that independently and asynchronously respond to brightness changes at microsecond resolution, supporting state estimation under rapid motion, motion blur, and high dynamic range (HDR) illumination. This also enables capture of high-frequency blinking patterns from light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Based on this, we propose a real-time event-based framework for LED tracking and six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) relative pose estimation using pulse-width modulation (PWM)-encoded LED markers. Multiple LEDs share a common blinking frequency and encode identities through distinct PWM duty cycles, reducing frequency-resource requirements and computational cost. Our dual-rate asynchronous tracking framework combines low-rate LED detection with high-rate raw-event updates, maintaining robust LED identity association and accurate pixel-level tracking under rapid motion. LED identities and positions establish reliable 2D-3D correspondences for real-time metric 6-DoF relative pose estimation. Extensive evaluations on a self-collected dataset demonstrate robustness under large motion flow and transient image-plane LED overlap. Furthermore, we develop a coordinated robotic platform comprising a quadrotor and a Mecanum-wheeled mobile robot, demonstrating the proposed framework's potential for closed-loop drone guidance through hovering and target-following experiments under time-varying HDR illumination, with onboard deployment on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. The dataset and implementation will be released to facilitate further research.
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机像素以微秒级异步响应亮度变化，可在快速运动、运动模糊和HDR照明下工作，并能捕获LED高频闪烁。本文提出基于PWM编码LED标记的实时事件框架，实现LED跟踪与6-DoF相对位姿估计。多个LED共享闪烁频率、以不同占空比编码身份，降低频率资源与计算成本；双速率异步跟踪结合低速率检测与高速率事件更新，在快速运动下保持身份关联和像素级跟踪，并建立2D-3D对应实现实时度量位姿估计。自采数据与四旋翼-麦克纳姆轮平台实验验证了鲁棒性及机载闭环引导潜力。
items.highlight_zh: 用PWM占空比编码LED身份，实现事件相机实时6-DoF位姿估计
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：在高速运动、运动模糊和强/弱光并存的HDR场景中，传统相机难以稳定跟踪标记并估计无人机等平台的相对位姿。方法：利用事件相机对亮度变化微秒级响应的特性，设计PWM编码LED标记——多个LED共用同一闪烁频率，仅用不同占空比区分身份，减少频段占用和识别计算；再用双速率异步框架，低速检测LED、高速用原始事件更新位置，维持身份关联与像素级跟踪，并由LED的2D观测和已知3D位置求解实时6-DoF度量位姿。结果：自采数据表明，在大运动流和LED在像面短暂重叠时仍能稳定工作；在四旋翼与麦克纳姆轮机器人组成的平台上，于时变HDR照明下完成悬停和目标跟随，并部署在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上。意义：为事件相机提供低资源、可机载的实时位姿估计方案，展示闭环无人机引导潜力。
items.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

items.title_en: RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: RangeNav：面向机器人导航的任务对齐 LiDAR 距离图像预训练
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require $360^\circ$ perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation. We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning. In simulation, adding semantic and BEV supervision increases success rates over a reconstruction-only baseline by an average of 32.03 and 23.73 percentage points (pp) in procedurally generated training and out-of-distribution realistic test environments, respectively. Zero-shot real-world deployments on a Unitree B2-W quadruped demonstrate robust navigation through dense crowds, low-light settings, and construction zones where limited-field-of-view depth policies struggle. Code and models will be open-sourced. Project website: https://rangenav.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 在密集人群与杂乱场地中作业的自主移动机器人需要 360° 感知来应对周围危险。全景 LiDAR 可提供全向覆盖，但在稀疏奖励下用强化学习（RL）学习表征样本效率低，现有 3D 预训练点云编码器对大规模并行 RL 仿真而言显存开销又过大。为此我们提出 RangeNav：一个仅 183k 参数、完全在合成数据上预训练的紧凑 LiDAR 距离图像编码器，采用各向异性卷积与循环填充处理距离图像极端的宽高比与方位角接缝，并以结合距离重建、语义分割与鸟瞰图（BEV）预测的导航对齐目标预训练，随后冻结用于策略学习。仿真中，相较仅重建基线，加入语义与 BEV 监督使成功率在程序化训练环境和分布外真实感测试环境中分别平均提升 32.03 与 23.73 个百分点。Unitree B2-W 四足机器人上的零样本实机部署表明，该方法在密集人群、低光与施工区域中导航稳健，而有限视场的深度策略在这些场景中表现不佳。
items.highlight_zh: 183k 参数距离图像编码器，语义+BEV 预训练显著提升导航成功率
items.digest_zh:
- 研究了什么问题：在拥挤人群、杂乱工地里跑的四足/移动机器人，需要 360° 环视才能及时避开危险。全景 LiDAR 能给全向覆盖，但直接用强化学习从零学感知表征，在稀疏奖励下极耗样本；现成的 3D 点云预训练编码器又太占显存，撑不起动辄上千个并行环境的 RL 训练。
- 用了什么方法：作者把 LiDAR 数据转成“距离图像”（像把一圈激光测距展开成一张二维图），设计只有 18.3 万参数的小编码器 RangeNav。因为这张图特别“扁”（方位角极大、俯仰角极小），左右两端其实相连，他们用各向异性卷积（横竖方向感受野不同）和循环填充处理宽高比与接缝。预训练全用合成数据，目标特意“对齐导航”：不只重建距离，还要预测语义分割和鸟瞰图（BEV）。训练好就冻结编码器，再学 RL 策略。
- 得到什么结果：在程序生成的训练场景和分布外真实感测试场景中，相比只用重建的基线，加入语义与 BEV 监督使成功率分别平均提高 32.03 和 23.73 个百分点。在 Unitree B2-W 四足机器人上零样本部署，可在密集人群、低光、施工区穿行，而视场受限的深度策略在这些场景频繁失败。
- 为何重要：说明“小模型 + 任务对齐的自监督预训练”足以让全向 LiDAR 在真实机器人上稳定落地，省算力、省样本，也让大规模并行 RL 训练变得可行。
items.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Added project website to abstract and updated author affiliation; research content unchanged

rm.usage: 轻量 LiDAR 距离图像编码器（183k 参数）+ 冻结表征供 RL 策略学习，可给哨兵导航提供「全景激光感知前端 + 预训练表征」的思路，降低稀疏奖励下的训练成本。需在 RM 场地尺寸、传感器布置与算力条件下重训/验证，且它是感知编码器而非完整导航决策，不能直接当作哨兵全场自主系统。

items.title_en: GGraph: A GPU-Accelerated Library for Graph-Based Robot Deployment and Learning
items.title_zh: GGraph：面向机器人部署与学习的 GPU 加速图库
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots require spatial representations that capture geometry and semantics while staying sparse enough for planning in large, unknown environments. Graphs provide a natural representation for this purpose and underpin both classical planning methods and a growing class of reinforcement-learning (RL) policies. However, RL training needs hundreds to thousands of parallel environments, each constructing and updating its own graph. Existing graph libraries are typically designed for either single-robot deployment or fixed graphs, and CPU-based graph construction limits scalable training to only a few dozen environments. We introduce GGraph, an open-source GPU-accelerated graph library for both robot deployment and large-scale learning. GGraph supports real robots through ROS 2 interfaces and vectorized GPU-based policy training, with built-in support for tasks including 3-D navigation, exploration, and loop-closure integration. For single-robot operation, GGraph updates graphs in milliseconds. At scale, it enables graph-based exploration policies to train across hundreds of parallel robots, reducing wall-clock training time by one order of magnitude. Across simulation and real-world experiments, these results establish GGraph as a unified graph infrastructure for both large-scale robot learning and deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人需要既能捕捉几何与语义、又足够稀疏以支撑大型未知环境中规划的空间表征。图为此提供了自然表示，既支撑经典规划方法，也支撑日益增多的强化学习（RL）策略。然而 RL 训练需要成百上千个并行环境，每个环境都要构建并更新自己的图；现有图库多面向单机器人部署或固定图，且基于 CPU 的图构建使可扩展训练只能限于数十个环境。我们提出 GGraph，一个开源的 GPU 加速图库，同时服务机器人部署与大规模学习：它通过 ROS 2 接口支持真实机器人，提供向量化的 GPU 策略训练，并内置三维导航、探索与回环检测集成等任务支持。单机器人运行时图更新为毫秒级；规模化时，基于图的探索策略可在数百个并行机器人上训练，将实际训练时间缩短一个数量级。仿真与真实实验共同表明 GGraph 可作为机器人学习与部署的统一图基础设施。
items.highlight_zh: GPU 加速图库，支持数百并行机器人图策略训练，耗时降一个数量级
items.digest_zh:
- 研究了什么问题：机器人在未知大环境里规划，需要一种既包含几何又包含语义、同时保持稀疏的表示，图结构正好合适，经典规划与图强化学习都依赖它。但 RL 训练要成百上千个并行环境，每个环境各自建图、更新图；现有图库要么只考虑单个真实机器人部署，要么假设图是固定的，而且建图多在 CPU 上完成，并行规模只能到几十个环境。
- 用了什么方法：作者做了 GGraph，一个开源的 GPU 加速图库，一套代码同时覆盖“部署”和“训练”：对真实机器人提供 ROS 2 接口；对训练提供向量化的 GPU 并行建图与策略学习。内置三维导航、探索、回环检测（loop closure）融合等常见任务支撑。
- 得到什么结果：单机器人运行时，图更新在毫秒级；规模化时，基于图的探索策略可同时在数百个并行机器人上训练，把实际训练耗时缩短一个数量级（约十倍）。仿真与真实实验都验证了这一点。
- 为何重要：过去“训练用的图”和“部署用的图”是两套东西，图构建还是训练吞吐的瓶颈。GGraph 把它统一到 GPU 上，让图这一经典表示也能享受大规模并行 RL 的红利。
items.comment: 9 pages, 11 figures

rm.usage: GPU 加速图结构库，可支撑哨兵导航的图表示建图/探索与大规模并行策略训练，或用 ROS 2 接口做部署侧图更新。属通用基础设施，不自带 RM 战术环境与奖励设计，落地价值主要是工程支撑而非算法本身。

items.title_en: LACART: Lookahead-Augmented Collision Avoidance and Reference Tracking Strategies for Safety-Critical Robots
items.title_zh: LACART：面向安全关键机器人的前瞻增强避碰与参考跟踪策略
items.abstract_en: Autonomous racing provides a demanding testbed for collision avoidance under tight geometric and computational constraints. Building on a recent conference contribution and a master's dissertation, LACART combines lookahead-based control barrier functions (CBFs), a relaxed control Lyapunov function (CLF), and quadratic programming (QP) to modify nominal vehicle commands for obstacle avoidance and reference tracking. The method handles circular obstacles and track boundaries in a common optimisation layer. Comparative simulation results against Huang \emph{et al.} \cite{r9} show similar full-track paths and lower median computation times: 0.31 versus 0.33 ms per step and 0.023 versus 0.025 ms per QP solve. The dissertation further demonstrates a 1:43-scale vehicle with camera-based estimation and wireless actuation at a reported 25 Hz control rate. We identify the conditions linking lookahead-point clearance to body clearance, illustrate hardware limitations, and propose a recorded demonstration of safety intervention and recovery. The contribution targets ground-robot collision avoidance and real-time safety monitoring.
items.abstract_zh: 自主赛车为严格几何与计算约束下的避碰提供了高要求测试平台。LACART 基于近期会议论文与硕士论文，结合前瞻控制屏障函数（CBF）、松弛控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）与二次规划（QP），修正车辆标称指令以避障并跟踪参考。方法在统一优化层处理圆形障碍与赛道边界。与 Huang 等对比仿真显示全赛道路径相近，中位计算时间更低：每步 0.31 对 0.33 ms，每次 QP 0.023 对 0.025 ms。还展示 1:43 比例车辆，相机估计与无线执行，报告 25 Hz 控制。识别前瞻点间隙与车身间隙关联条件，说明硬件限制，并给出安全干预与恢复演示。面向地面机器人避碰与实时安全监控。
items.highlight_zh: 前瞻CBF+松弛CLF统一QP，避碰更快
items.digest_zh: 这篇论文关注小型/地面机器人在赛道这类狭窄空间里如何既不撞障碍又跟住目标路线，而且计算必须足够快，能实时运行。作者提出 LACART：把“前瞻”思路引入控制屏障函数（CBF），提前看前方一段路径来判断安全；再用松弛的控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）负责跟踪参考；二者与二次规划（QP）放在同一个优化层里，统一处理圆形障碍和赛道边界，输出对车辆标称指令的修正。仿真中与 Huang 等人的方法相比，跑完整赛道的路径几乎一样，但中位计算时间略低：每步约 0.31 ms 对 0.33 ms，单次 QP 约 0.023 ms 对 0.025 ms。作者还在 1:43 比例小车上用相机估计和无线执行做了演示，报告 25 Hz 控制频率；并分析了“前瞻点安全距离”与“车身实际安全距离”在什么条件下能对应，指出硬件限制，计划展示安全干预与恢复过程。其意义在于把避碰与跟踪放进实时优化框架，并强调安全监控，对地面机器人自主导航有参考价值。

rm.usage: 前瞻 CBF + 松弛 CLF + QP 的安全避障层，计算量约 0.3ms/步，可作为哨兵在局部避障/安全兜底模块的最小改动方案（在标称速度指令上做安全修正）。需把赛道边界/圆形障碍假设替换为 RM 场地障碍与机器人间安全距离，并验证实车定位噪声下的表现。

items.title_en: Omni-IGN: Onboard Image-Goal Navigation for Drones with Omnidirectional Vision
items.title_zh: Omni-IGN：面向无人机的全向视觉机载图像目标导航
items.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation (ImageNav) requires an agent to reach a location specified by a goal image in an unknown environment. For drones, this task demands exploration, goal- directed navigation, and collision avoidance under limited onboard computing resources. Existing aerial ImageNav methods are built on single-view observations, requiring additional rotation and exploration to search for goal-relevant cues outside the field of view. In this paper, we present Omni-IGN, a fully onboard ImageNav system that integrates quad-fisheye perception, an attention-based reinforcement learning (RL) policy, and a collision-aware safety layer. The policy adaptively fuses goal-relevant features across multiple views to provide directional guidance for continuous navigation. The quad-fisheye RGB images support both ImageNav and obstacle avoidance without a dedicated depth sensor. On Habitat benchmarks, Omni-IGN achieves the best performance among continuous-action baselines. Moreover, flight tests in IsaacSim validate the effectiveness of integrating learning-based depth estimation with the action safety layer for collision avoidance. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer without any fine-tuning or external localization. The code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体在未知环境中抵达由目标图像指定的位置。对无人机而言，该任务需在有限机载算力下同时完成探索、目标导向导航与避障。现有空中 ImageNav 方法基于单视图观测，需要额外旋转与探索才能找到视野外的目标相关线索。本文提出 Omni-IGN，一个完全机载的 ImageNav 系统，融合四鱼眼感知、基于注意力的强化学习（RL）策略与碰撞感知安全层。策略自适应融合多视图中的目标相关特征，为连续导航提供方向引导；四鱼眼 RGB 图像同时支持 ImageNav 与避障，无需专用深度传感器。在 Habitat 基准上，Omni-IGN 在连续动作基线中表现最佳；IsaacSim 飞行测试验证了学习式深度估计与动作安全层结合用于避障的有效性；真实世界实验则展示了无需微调或外部定位的零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。
items.highlight_zh: 四鱼眼全向视觉+注意力 RL+安全层，实现无人机零样本真机导航
items.digest_zh:
- 研究了什么问题：图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体只看一张目标照片，就在陌生环境里走到那个位置。对无人机更难：要在机载有限算力下同时完成探索、朝目标飞和避障。现有空中方案多为单视图，视野外的目标线索只能靠原地转圈和额外探索去找，效率低。
- 用了什么方法：作者提出 Omni-IGN，一个全部跑在机上的系统，由三部分组成：四个鱼眼相机组成的全向 RGB 感知（不装专用深度传感器）、基于注意力的强化学习策略、以及碰撞感知的安全层。策略自适应地在多个视角间融合目标相关特征，输出连续控制指令；同一套鱼眼图像既用于导航也用于判断障碍。安全层借助基于学习的深度估计对动作做碰撞过滤。
- 得到什么结果：在 Habitat 基准上，Omni-IGN 在连续动作基线中表现最好。IsaacSim 飞行测试验证了“学习式深度估计 + 动作安全层”确实能有效避障。真机实验中实现了零样本 sim-to-real：不微调、也不用外部定位系统就能飞行。
- 为何重要：全向视觉让无人机“看一眼就够”，省掉了为扩大视野而做的机动与探索；把安全层与学习策略解耦，也使仿真训练的策略更容易迁移到真机，对算力受限的机载平台尤其有意义。

rm.usage: 四鱼眼全向视觉 + RL 策略 + 碰撞安全层的全机载图像目标导航，思路可用于空中机器人「机库内自主起飞定位、按目标图像飞向指定区域、无专用深度传感器避障」。但方法在 Habitat/IsaacSim 训练、零样本迁移依赖场景相似性，落地需在 RM 室内场地重建地图与定位方案，并注意赛场禁止 Wi-Fi/BLE/UWB 组网、机间/机库链路只能走可见光或库内近场。

items.title_en: TransNav: Transformer-Based End-to-End Navigation Method for Static and Dynamic Quadrotor Obstacle Avoidance
items.title_zh: TransNav：面向静态与动态四旋翼避障的基于 Transformer 的端到端导航方法
items.abstract_en: Obstacle avoidance for autonomous quadrotors in cluttered environments remains challenging, especially when both dense static obstacles and moving obstacles are present. Existing methods are often tailored to either static or dynamic settings, which always limit their adaptability across diverse environments. This paper presents TransNav, a transformer-based end-to-end navigation method for quadrotor obstacle avoidance in both static and dynamic environments. TransNav employs a patch-based point-cloud encoding scheme that combines local feature extraction with global contextual modeling, enabling compact yet informative environment representation. The method integrates perception and navigation in a single architecture and directly predicts a finite-horizon action sequence, from which the first action is executed. Moreover, we develop an unsupervised learning strategy by incorporating a lightweight point-mass dynamics model, which directly optimizes trajectory-level costs over the predicted sequence through numerical gradient propagation. Thus, the policy can be efficiently trained without expert demonstrations. Simulation and real-world experiments show that the proposed method achieves strong performance in dense static environments and competitive obstacle-avoidance capability in dynamic scenarios, while maintaining low inference cost for onboard deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 在杂乱环境中为自主四旋翼飞行器避障仍具挑战，尤其当环境中同时存在密集静态障碍与动态障碍时。现有方法往往只针对静态或动态单一场景设计，适应性受限。本文提出 TransNav，一种基于 Transformer 的端到端导航方法，可同时应对静态与动态环境下的四旋翼避障。TransNav 采用基于块（patch）的点云编码方案，将局部特征提取与全局上下文建模相结合，得到紧凑而信息丰富的环境表征。该方法将感知与导航集成于单一架构，直接预测有限时域内的动作序列，并执行其中第一个动作。此外，作者引入轻量级质点动力学模型，构建无监督学习策略，通过数值梯度传播直接对预测序列上的轨迹级代价进行优化，从而无需专家示范即可高效训练策略。仿真与真实实验表明，该方法在密集静态环境中性能优异，在动态场景中具备有竞争力的避障能力，同时保持较低的推理开销，适合机载部署。
items.highlight_zh: Transformer 端到端四旋翼避障，无需专家示范即可训练
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：四旋翼无人机在同时存在密集静态障碍和移动障碍的杂乱环境里如何自主避障。以往方法通常是为静态场景或动态场景单独定制，换一种环境就可能失效，缺乏通用性。

方法思路：作者提出 TransNav，把“看环境”和“决定怎么飞”合成一个网络。点云被切成小块（patch）后编码，既能捕捉障碍物的局部细节，又能用 Transformer 建立全局上下文，从而用较小的数据量描述复杂环境。网络直接输出未来一小段时间内的动作序列，实际只执行第一个动作，再滚动重规划——这是典型的模型预测式滚动控制思路。

训练方式：最大的巧思在于不依赖专家示范（即不需要人飞出来的“标准答案”轨迹）。作者把轻量质点动力学模型嵌入训练流程，让预测动作序列经动力学推演后计算轨迹级代价（如是否碰撞、是否平滑），再用数值梯度把这个代价反传回网络参数，形成无监督式优化。这样策略可以高效训练。

实验结果：仿真和真机实验显示，在密集静态环境中表现很强，在动态场景中避障能力也具竞争力；同时推理开销低，能满足机载实时部署。

意义：它说明一个统一的 Transformer 架构可以跨静态/动态场景通用，并且用可微动力学+轨迹代价替代人工示范，大幅降低数据成本，对无人机自主导航的工程落地有实际价值。
items.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)

rm.usage: 基于点云 patch 编码的 Transformer 端到端四旋翼避障，输出有限时长动作序列、推理开销低，可作为空中机器人室内避障与轨迹规划的候选方案参考。需评估机载点云传感器载荷、算力与 4Wh 电池能量约束，并解决 RM 场地的室内定位前提（不依赖外部动捕/GPS），不能当作可直接上场的整机方案。

items.title_en: OASIS: Optimization-Aware Subgoal Inference with Safety Constraints for Autonomous Mobile Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: OASIS：面向自主移动机器人导航的安全约束优化感知子目标推断
items.abstract_en: Navigation in dynamic environments requires mobile robots to make progress toward their goals while respecting motion limits and avoiding surrounding obstacles. Learned subgoal policies can guide model predictive control beyond its local prediction horizon, but a geometrically suitable subgoal does not necessarily lead to a successfully solved control problem. This paper proposes OASIS, a hierarchical navigation framework that incorporates recent optimization outcomes into reinforcement learning-based subgoal generation. A high-level policy trained using Soft Actor--Critic generates local subgoals, while a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks them subject to motion limits, geometric collision-avoidance constraints, and embedded high-order control barrier function constraints. The outcomes of controller optimizations over each subgoal interval are summarized and provided to the policy at its next decision, without requiring additional optimization calls. The framework is evaluated in five navigation scenarios with static and moving obstacles, including dense interactions and sensing uncertainty. Comparisons with hierarchical and direct-goal control variants show that OASIS achieves the highest aggregate navigation success. Matched comparisons across three training seeds further show a consistent success advantage over the otherwise identical hierarchy without optimization-status input. The selected-policy comparison also shows fewer primary optimization failures with similar mean controller time.
items.abstract_zh: 动态环境中的导航要求移动机器人在遵守运动限制并避开周围障碍的同时朝目标推进。学习到的子目标策略可以引导模型预测控制超越其局部预测时域，但几何上合适的子目标并不一定带来成功求解的控制问题。本文提出OASIS，一种将近期优化结果纳入基于强化学习的子目标生成的层次化导航框架。使用Soft Actor–Critic训练的高层策略生成局部子目标，而非线性模型预测控制器在运动限制、几何避碰约束和嵌入式高阶控制屏障函数约束下跟踪这些子目标。每个子目标区间内控制器优化的结果被总结，并在下一次决策时提供给策略，而无需额外优化调用。该框架在五个具有静态和移动障碍物的导航场景中评估，包括密集交互和感知不确定性。与层次化和直接目标控制变体比较，OASIS获得最高的总体导航成功率。在三个训练种子上的匹配比较进一步表明，相对于没有优化状态输入的其余相同层次结构，其具有一致的成功率优势。所选策略比较还显示，在相似的平均控制器时间下，主要优化失败更少。

rm.usage: 可借鉴其“高层 RL 生成局部子目标 + NMPC 带运动学/避障约束跟踪”的分层结构，用于哨兵在动态对抗中的路径规划与局部绕障；需替换成 RM 场地图、真实底盘功率/运动约束与雷达可接收信息，不能直接用其仿真环境与策略。

items.title_en: Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration
items.title_zh: 超越内存限制：面向大规模三维自主探索的层次化时空地图表示
items.abstract_en: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon exploration.We present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future revisits.Upon returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task context.FLAVOR achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机探索越来越多用于难以进入或受灾害影响环境中的大规模测绘和巡检，而这些环境中的机载内存和计算资源通常严重受限。大多数现有无人机探索系统维护可全局查询的几何地图表示以用于运动规划和探索决策，导致内存消耗和空间查询成本随已探索区域增加。以机器人为中心的局部建图限制了密集地图的内存和计算，但丢弃了长时程探索所需的全局任务上下文。我们提出FLAVOR，一种层次化时空框架，将密集度量几何限制在以机器人为中心的局部地图中，同时保留紧凑的全局观测和任务上下文。在观测层，轻量级LiDAR关键帧可见性记录保留用于前沿推理的逐射线证据。在任务层，超出局部地图范围且未解决的前沿被保留为与里程计锚点关联的紧凑待处理任务。稀疏拓扑图通过保留的路线连接这些锚点，以便未来重访。返回任务区域时，FLAVOR从观测中重建前沿和探索视点，同时拓扑路线被实例化，并在执行前依据当前局部地图进行验证。随着探索扩展，密集地图容量保持固定，依赖探索的内存增长被限制在紧凑的观测和任务上下文中。FLAVOR比完成所有三个仿真场景的最佳基线实现短31.98–41.88%的探索时间和小94–99%的地图内存占用。在真实部署中，相对于显式点云ikd-tree，它在森林中将该占用减少92.67%，在建筑工地减少62.42%，同时在受限机载资源下保持长期任务连续性。
items.comment: 16 pages, 12 figures, preprint submitted to Elsevier

items.title_en: RAVEN: A Unified Active SLAM System for Rapid Autonomous Visual Exploration with Aerial Robots under Localization Uncertainty
items.title_zh: RAVEN：面向空中机器人在定位不确定性下快速自主视觉探索的统一主动 SLAM 系统
items.abstract_en: Active simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) addresses the problem of planning robot motion to build complete and accurate maps of unknown environments through efficient exploration while maintaining high localization accuracy. This raises a dilemma between exploring unknown spaces to expand coverage and exploiting visited regions to perform active loop closures. Despite numerous prior works on ground robots, aerial robots with high agility and constrained sensor suites face more significant localization drift and thereby demand dedicated active SLAM planning. Moreover, a unified strategy that adapts performance based on task-specific priorities remains an open question. In this article, we introduce RAVEN, a unified active SLAM framework for Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN using quadrotors, which systematically accounts for localization uncertainty. The framework starts with identifying frontiers and active loop closure candidates, from which global tour candidates are generated. These candidates are evaluated using a utility vector that separately quantifies exploration efficiency and localization accuracy, and the final tour is selected according to a prioritization parameter ranging from $[0,1]$. Finally, a perception-aware navigation planner generates smooth execution trajectories that minimize visual state estimation error based on the online Fisher information field that provides visual localization information in real-time. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that RAVEN outperforms state-of-the-art active SLAM methods, highlighting its advantages in producing a spectrum of performance across prioritizations. Fully onboard field experiments with a customized stereo-inertial quadrotor further validate its practical applicability in challenging environments. The source code will be released to benefit the community.
items.abstract_zh: 主动同时定位与建图（SLAM）解决的是通过高效探索规划机器人运动，以在未知环境中构建完整、准确地图并保持高定位精度的问题。这带来了在探索未知空间以扩大覆盖与利用已访问区域进行主动回环闭合之间的两难。尽管地面机器人已有大量先前工作，但具有高敏捷性和受限传感器配置的空中机器人面临更显著的定位漂移，因而需要专门的主动 SLAM 规划。此外，能够根据任务特定优先级自适应调整性能的统一策略仍是一个开放问题。本文提出 RAVEN，一个用于四旋翼快速自主视觉探索（Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN）并系统考虑定位不确定性的统一主动 SLAM 框架。该框架首先识别前沿和主动回环闭合候选，并由此生成全局巡游候选。这些候选通过一个分别量化探索效率和定位精度的效用向量进行评估，最终巡游依据取值范围为 [0,1] 的优先级参数进行选择。最后，感知感知导航规划器基于实时提供视觉定位信息的在线 Fisher 信息场，生成使视觉状态估计误差最小化的平滑执行轨迹。基准评测表明 RAVEN 优于当前最先进的主动 SLAM 方法，凸显其在不同优先级下产生一系列性能表现的优势。使用定制立体-惯性四旋翼进行的完全机载现场实验进一步验证了其在挑战性环境中的实际适用性。源代码将发布以惠及社区。

items.title_en: TravSUITE: Traversability via Self-Supervised, Uncertainty-Aware IRL and Terrain Estimation
items.title_zh: TravSUITE：基于自监督、不确定性感知IRL与地形估计的可通行性
items.abstract_en: Traversability analysis in off-road settings remains a fundamental challenge for mobile robots. Key difficulties include constructing an accurate and expressive local map from multimodal sensor data, and using the map to design traversability rules that yield desirable navigation behavior. Importantly, this system must be resilient to the limited sensing regime brought about by complex environments and high speeds. In this paper, we present TravSUITE, a traversability system suitable for high-speed navigation in off-road environments. TravSUITE consists of two major components: 1) an efficient voxel mapper that leverages visual foundation models (VFMs) to build a rich geometric-semantic local map from streams of on-board sensor data, and 2) a unified neural network that jointly predicts traversability-relevant quantities in bird's eye view (BEV), including geometry, semantics, speed and cost. Our training strategy is entirely annotation-free and self-supervised, leveraging tasks such as map inpainting and inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) to learn both map representations and traversability. We perform a thorough ablation study and comparison to state-of-the-art approaches, and the results indicate that cost learning and auxiliary inpainting each contribute significantly to planning quality, and their combination is critical for achieving state-of-the-art performance in off-road path planning. We also design a simple risk adaptation mechanism to leverage our method's uncertainty estimates at deploy-time, and demonstrate that a combination of inpainting and risk estimation can result in 80% fewer navigation errors and 5% faster autonomous traversal speeds in real-world hardware experiments.
items.abstract_zh: 越野环境中的可通行性分析仍然是移动机器人的一项基本挑战。关键困难包括从多模态传感器数据构建准确且具有表现力的局部地图，以及利用该地图设计可产生理想导航行为的可通行性规则。重要的是，该系统必须能够适应复杂环境和高速度带来的有限感知条件。本文提出TravSUITE，一种适用于越野环境高速导航的可通行性系统。TravSUITE由两个主要部分组成：1）高效体素建图器，利用视觉基础模型（VFM）从车载传感器数据流构建丰富的几何-语义局部地图；2）统一神经网络，在鸟瞰图（BEV）中联合预测与可通行性相关的量，包括几何、语义、速度和代价。我们的训练策略完全无需标注且为自监督，利用地图修复和逆强化学习（IRL）等任务同时学习地图表示和可通行性。我们进行了全面的消融研究并与最先进方法比较，结果表明代价学习和辅助修复各自对规划质量有显著贡献，二者的结合对于在越野路径规划中达到最先进性能至关重要。我们还设计了一种简单的风险适应机制，以在部署时利用该方法的不确定性估计，并证明在真实硬件实验中，修复与风险估计的结合可使导航错误减少80%，自主通行速度提高5%。

items.title_en: Recon2Servo: Robotic Ultrasound Visual Servoing via Learned Image-to-Motion Inference
items.title_zh: Recon2Servo：通过学习的图像到运动推断实现机器人超声视觉伺服
items.abstract_en: Ultrasound visual servoing is essential for autonomous robotic ultrasound, yet 6-DoF probe control from 2D B-mode images remains challenging due to limited and ambiguous out-of-plane motion cues. Existing methods typically rely on anatomical priors or handcrafted visual features, limiting their generalizability across imaging targets. Inspired by trackerless 3D ultrasound reconstruction, we propose Recon2Servo, a visual servoing framework that learns image-to-motion inference directly from B-mode images for 6-DoF probe control. A DINOv3 encoder with low-rank adaptation and a bidirectional relation module estimate the relative probe pose between current and target images to guide iterative closed-loop target-view alignment. The framework combines supervised relative-pose learning, reconstruction-guided closed-loop adaptation, and bounded residual pose correction to improve motion inference during servoing. Evaluations on a public dataset and an in-house dataset collected from 12 healthy volunteers using different ultrasound systems demonstrate its effectiveness in reconstructed-volume servoing. Additional real-robot demonstrations of target-view alignment and dynamic tracking on a human forearm are provided in the supplementary video: https://youtu.be/qwsOdI-GMYk.
items.abstract_zh: 超声视觉伺服对于自主机器人超声至关重要，然而由于有限且模糊的平面外运动线索，从二维B模式图像进行6自由度探头控制仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖解剖先验或手工设计的视觉特征，限制了其在不同成像目标间的泛化能力。受无跟踪器三维超声重建启发，我们提出Recon2Servo，一个直接从B模式图像学习图像到运动推断以进行6自由度探头控制的视觉伺服框架。一个带有低秩适应的DINOv3编码器和一个双向关系模块估计当前图像与目标图像之间的相对探头位姿，以引导迭代闭环目标视图对齐。该框架结合监督式相对位姿学习、重建引导的闭环适应和有界残差位姿校正，以改善伺服过程中的运动推断。在公共数据集和使用不同超声系统从12名健康志愿者采集的内部数据集上的评估表明，其在重建体积伺服中的有效性。补充视频中还提供了在人体前臂上进行目标视图对齐和动态跟踪的真实机器人演示：https://youtu.be/qwsOdI-GMYk。

items.title_en: BRACE: Belief-guided Residual Adaptive Control for Safe Navigation under Unknown Disturbances
items.title_zh: BRACE：未知扰动下安全导航的信念引导残差自适应控制
items.abstract_en: Disturbances encountered during autonomous navigation generally vary across space, often discontinuously, as obstacles redirect wind and changing terrain alters traction. Tracking controllers typically assume sufficient control authority to mitigate disturbances and maintain safety; the regime where this assumption fails remains underexplored. We present Belief-guided Residual Adaptive Control (BRACE), a hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework for reach-avoid navigation under unknown, bounded, spatially varying disturbances. BRACE infers a disturbance belief from model prediction errors and uses that to condition a high-level policy that adapts the reference trajectory. The policy combines a nominal and a belief-guided residual term, trained jointly with a likelihood-ratio advantage reweighting heuristic. We evaluate BRACE in three simulated quadcopter environments with abruptly switching wind fields, and validate it on Crazyflie hardware with fan-generated disturbances. Across these settings, BRACE improves reach-avoid performance over model predictive control and RL baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 自主导航中遇到的扰动通常随空间变化，且常常不连续，因为障碍物会改变风向，变化的地形会改变牵引力。跟踪控制器通常假设具有足够的控制权限来缓解扰动并保持安全；这一假设失效的情形仍未得到充分探索。我们提出信念引导残差自适应控制（BRACE），一种用于未知、有界、空间变化扰动下到达—避障导航的层次化强化学习框架。BRACE从模型预测误差中推断扰动信念，并用其调节高层策略以调整参考轨迹。该策略结合标称项和信念引导残差项，并使用似然比优势重加权启发式联合训练。我们在三个具有突变风场的仿真四旋翼环境中评估BRACE，并在带有风扇生成扰动的Crazyflie硬件上验证。在这些设置中，BRACE相对于模型预测控制和强化学习基线提高了到达—避障性能。

items.title_en: An Integrated Open-Source Stack for Vision-Based Autonomous Navigation of Wheeled Rovers
items.title_zh: 用于轮式漫游车视觉自主导航的集成开源栈
items.abstract_en: Vision-based rover autonomy requires integrating perception, localization, planning and platform-specific control under limited sensing and computing resources. We present an open-source ROS 2 stack for following directional arrows, reaching a terminal cone and returning autonomously to the start. It connects YOLOv8n detection and geometric direction, range and bearing estimation with RGB-D SLAM, wheel-inertial state estimation, kinematics-aware planning, behavior-tree mission management and STM32 actuation. Standard interfaces separate reusable autonomy from the hardware layer; a proportional path-following plugin supports low-speed rover motion. Public resources include software, configuration, a labeled dataset, trained weights and evaluation logs. On 478 held-out images, the detector achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.720 under the Ultralytics evaluator and outperforms a classical OpenCV baseline under a shared evaluation protocol. The reported perception latency is 25 ms on a Jetson Orin NX. Three missions, one indoor and two outdoor, demonstrate marker-guided navigation and autonomous return without operator motion commands or reported collisions. Field results document integration failures and corrective choices; repeated instrumented trials remain necessary to quantify physical navigation errors and reliability.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的漫游车自主性需要在有限传感和计算资源下集成感知、定位、规划和平台特定控制。我们提出一个开源ROS 2栈，用于跟随方向箭头、到达终端锥桶并自主返回起点。它将YOLOv8n检测以及几何方向、距离和方位估计与RGB-D SLAM、轮式惯性状态估计、运动学感知规划、行为树任务管理和STM32执行器连接起来。标准接口将可复用自主性与硬件层分离；比例路径跟随插件支持低速漫游车运动。公共资源包括软件、配置、标注数据集、训练权重和评估日志。在478张留出图像上，检测器在Ultralytics评估器下达到0.720的mAP@0.5，并在共享评估协议下优于经典OpenCV基线。报告的在Jetson Orin NX上的感知延迟为25 ms。三个任务（一个室内和两个室外）展示了标记引导导航和自主返回，无需操作员运动命令且未报告碰撞。现场结果记录了集成失败和纠正选择；仍需要重复的仪器化试验来量化物理导航误差和可靠性。

items.title_en: CoReMatch: Recurrent Continuous Coordinate Refinement for Real-Time Robotic Feature Matching
items.title_zh: CoReMatch：面向实时机器人特征匹配的循环连续坐标细化
items.abstract_en: Feature matching underpins many robotic perception tasks, including visual localization, mapping, SLAM, and autonomous navigation. Existing semi-dense matchers predict confidence on fixed grids, limiting correspondences to predefined locations and requiring costly high-resolution grids for precise localization. We present CoReMatch (Coordinate Refinement Match), a recurrent framework that refines correspondences directly in continuous coordinate space rather than predicting discrete confidence maps. CoReMatch progressively improves correspondence estimates by propagating information across iterations. At the coarse stage, a Deep Aggregated Transformer captures global context and iteratively updates correspondence coordinates, while a lightweight regression head further sharpens their localization. Experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks show that CoReMatch strikes a strong balance between accuracy and efficiency, outperforming Efficient LoFTR in accuracy while running more than 10x faster on embedded edge hardware. These results demonstrate that recurrent coordinate refinement offers an efficient and scalable approach to real-time feature matching for robotic perception.
items.abstract_zh: 特征匹配支撑许多机器人感知任务，包括视觉定位、建图、SLAM和自主导航。现有半稠密匹配器在固定网格上预测置信度，将对应关系限制在预定义位置，并且需要昂贵的高分辨率网格才能实现精确定位。我们提出CoReMatch（坐标细化匹配），一个直接在连续坐标空间中细化对应关系而非预测离散置信图的循环框架。CoReMatch通过在迭代间传播信息逐步改进对应估计。在粗阶段，Deep Aggregated Transformer捕获全局上下文并迭代更新对应坐标，而轻量级回归头进一步锐化其定位。在室内和室外基准上的实验表明，CoReMatch在精度与效率之间取得了良好平衡，在精度上优于Efficient LoFTR，同时在嵌入式边缘硬件上运行速度快10倍以上。这些结果表明，循环坐标细化提供了一种高效且可扩展的方法，用于机器人感知中的实时特征匹配。

items.title_en: Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay
items.title_zh: 教一棵树恢复：利用反事实回放的LLM监督器在线蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots commonly pair a global planner with a local model predictive controller (MPC), but nonconvex obstacle avoidance and a limited horizon can make the robot freeze in complex layouts. Deciding whether to replan, wait, or call for help is a supervisory decision. Recent work queries a large language model (LLM) supervisor on every anomaly, which is slow and costly. We instead distill the LLM online into a decision tree. After each training episode, counterfactual replay labels recoveries as needed, unnecessary, or harmful. These labels retire unhelpful rules. In simulation, on 20 unseen layouts where the MPC alone freezes, the tree handles at least 18 correctly across all seeds, either by reaching the goal or by calling for help when no feasible path exists. The tree matches both an always-query LLM supervisor and expert-designed rules, while issuing no LLM queries at test time. Handwritten rules cannot anticipate the long tail of situations a physical robot will encounter. Online distillation is a promising remedy: the tree handles familiar cases, and the LLM is consulted only for new ones, whose validated recoveries become new rules. Language models can thus also serve as designers of supervisors rather than only as runtime supervisors.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人通常将全局规划器与局部模型预测控制器（MPC）配对，但非凸避障和有限时域可能导致机器人在复杂布局中冻结。决定是重新规划、等待还是求助，是一项监督决策。近期工作在每个异常发生时都查询大语言模型（LLM）监督器，这既慢又昂贵。我们改为将LLM在线蒸馏为决策树。在每个训练回合后，反事实回放将恢复操作标注为需要、不必要或有害。这些标签会淘汰无用的规则。在仿真中，对于仅靠MPC会冻结的20个未见布局，该决策树在所有随机种子下至少正确处理18个，要么到达目标，要么在不存在可行路径时求助。该决策树与始终查询的LLM监督器和专家设计的规则均相匹配，同时在测试时不发出任何LLM查询。手写规则无法预见物理机器人将遇到的长尾情况。在线蒸馏是一种有前景的补救方法：决策树处理熟悉情况，仅对新情况咨询LLM，而经过验证的恢复操作会成为新规则。因此，语言模型也可以充当监督器的设计者，而不仅是运行时监督器。

items.title_en: Integrating Flow Matching and Model Predictive Control for Safe Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 集成流匹配与模型预测控制的安全机器人导航
items.abstract_en: Learning-based path planners based on diffusion and flow matching can generate diverse trajectories from demonstrations but typically lack mechanisms for constraint satisfaction and collision avoidance during deployment. This work proposes a framework that combines flow-matching-based path planning with model predictive path-following control to integrate data-driven path generation with real-time, constraint-aware execution. The flow-matching model captures multimodal path distributions, while the predictive controller adapts motion online to satisfy state and input constraints and avoid obstacles using updated local sensor information. An event-triggered re-planning scheme incorporates predictive control solutions into subsequent path generation, promoting collision-free navigation in environments with previously unseen obstacles. Simulation results for mobile robot navigation demonstrate robust performance across cluttered environments. The framework provides a systematic approach to combining flow matching with predictive control for adaptive, data-driven navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于扩散和流匹配的学习型路径规划器可以从演示中生成多样化轨迹，但通常缺乏部署期间满足约束和避免碰撞的机制。本文提出一个将基于流匹配的路径规划与模型预测路径跟随控制相结合的框架，以将数据驱动的路径生成与实时、约束感知的执行相结合。流匹配模型捕获多模态路径分布，而预测控制器在线调整运动，以满足状态和输入约束，并利用更新的局部传感器信息避障。事件触发重规划方案将预测控制解纳入后续路径生成，促进在存在先前未见障碍物的环境中的无碰撞导航。移动机器人导航的仿真结果表明在杂乱环境中具有稳健性能。该框架提供了一种系统化方法，将流匹配与预测控制相结合，用于自适应、数据驱动的导航。

items.title_en: Not Losing Your Way: Mitigating Visual-Inertial Odometry Drift through On-Demand Visual Feature Creation
items.title_zh: 不迷失方向：通过按需创建视觉特征减轻视觉惯性里程计漂移
items.abstract_en: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) can degrade during aerial inspection in repetitive or poorly textured environments. We propose an active environment-modification framework for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) relying on cameras and an inertial measurement unit only, without prior maps or additional localization sensors. Inspired by the fairy tale of Tom Thumb, the UAV creates visual features on demand by releasing ground markers or marking walls through physical contact. An information-based indicator triggers interventions using temporal confirmation and hysteresis. Evaluation includes three simulated environments and a 900-run factorial campaign. Lower cruise speed and active marking are associated with reduced divergence, while accuracy among non-divergent runs depends on speed-strategy interactions. Corridor experiments, with five runs per configuration, use OptiTrack for flight control while VIO-based marking decisions remain active online. The combined framework reduces the reported position root mean square error by approximately 35% relative to baseline VIO, supporting active feature creation for drift mitigation.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉惯性里程计（VIO）在重复或纹理较差环境中的空中巡检期间可能退化。我们提出一种面向无人机（UAV）的主动环境修改框架，仅依赖相机和惯性测量单元，无需先验地图或额外定位传感器。受童话《拇指汤姆》启发，无人机通过释放地面标记或通过物理接触标记墙壁来按需创建视觉特征。基于信息的指标使用时间确认和滞后来触发干预。评估包括三个仿真环境和一项900次运行的析因实验。较低的巡航速度和主动标记与发散减少相关，而在未发散运行中的精度取决于速度与策略的交互。走廊实验中，每种配置运行五次，使用OptiTrack进行飞行控制，同时基于VIO的标记决策保持在线活跃。组合框架相对于基线VIO将报告的位置均方根误差降低约35%，支持通过主动特征创建减轻漂移。
items.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)

items.title_en: Beyond Terminal Constraints: Reliable Robot Control with Learned Safe Sets
items.title_zh: 超越终端约束：使用学习安全集的可靠机器人控制
items.abstract_en: Ensuring safety in advanced robot control methods such as Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning remains an open challenge. A common approach relies on control-invariant sets, yet their exact computation for nonlinear systems is generally intractable, and numerical approximations compromise theoretical guarantees. In this work, we show that safety does not need to rely exclusively on control invariance. We introduce novel classes of safe sets, each broader than classical control-invariant sets, and analyze corresponding MPC schemes that guarantee recursive feasibility by constraining different nodes of the prediction horizon rather than only the terminal state. Furthermore, when the safe set is an inner approximation of a suitable control-invariant set, our methods can ensure safety through a safe-abort strategy, even in the absence of recursive feasibility. We validate our approaches in extensive simulations on a 6-joint robot manipulator, showing fewer constraint violations than state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable tracking performance and computational efficiency. Hardware experiments further demonstrate the practicality of our schemes for real-world robotic applications.
items.abstract_zh: 在模型预测控制（MPC）和强化学习等先进机器人控制方法中确保安全性仍是一个未解决的挑战。一种常见方法依赖控制不变集，但其对非线性系统的精确计算通常难以处理，数值近似会损害理论保证。在这项工作中，我们表明安全性不必仅依赖控制不变性。我们引入新的安全集类别，每一类都比经典控制不变集更广，并分析相应的 MPC 方案：这些方案通过约束预测时域的不同节点而非仅终端状态来保证递归可行性。此外，当安全集是合适控制不变集的内近似时，即使不存在递归可行性，我们的方法也能通过安全中止策略确保安全性。我们在 6 关节机械臂上进行大量仿真验证，结果表明，与最先进方法相比，我们的方法在保持相当跟踪性能和计算效率的同时，约束违反更少。硬件实验进一步证明了我们的方案在真实机器人应用中的实用性。

items.title_en: VisGeo-PipeTrack: A Visual Geometric Servo Control Framework with MPC-RCAPID Control for UAV-Based Dynamic Pipes Tracking
items.title_zh: VisGeo-PipeTrack：一种基于MPC-RCAPID控制的无人机动态管道跟踪视觉几何伺服控制框架
items.abstract_en: While unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for pipeline inspection, prevailing research predominantly assumes static pipes. In real-world industrial environments, pipes often exhibit dynamic movements, such as vibrations. This imposes more stringent requirements on UAVs' adaptive control and computational efficiency than in static scenarios. Therefore, this paper proposes a servo control framework named VisGeo-PipeTrack, which utilizes geometric constraints to enable UAV tracking of dynamic pipes. To achieve efficient UAV positioning, YOLOv5 is employed to detect labels on the pipe. The positions are derived from visual geometric constraints based on these detected labels to enable precise localization. To address tracking control challenges, a model predictive control based real-time corrected adaptive PID (MPC-RCAPID) controller is proposed. This controller employs the Recursive Least Squares method for real-time model estimation and integrates rolling horizon optimization to dynamically adjust PID parameters. Experiments conducted on both the AirSim simulator and the Tello UAV platform validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Simulation comparisons with standard PID, fractional-order PID, adaptive PID, and fuzzy PID demonstrate that MPC-RCAPID achieves the shortest settling time (3.26 s) and the lowest average tracking error (3.52%). In physical experiments on the Tello platform, compared with standard PID control, MPC-RCAPID reduces the average tracking error by 55.52%, 26.72%, and 26.52% across the three test dimensions. These results demonstrate that VisGeo-PipeTrack facilitates efficient autonomous tracking in dynamic pipe environments.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管无人机（UAV）越来越多地被部署用于管道巡检，但现有研究大多假设管道是静态的。在实际工业环境中，管道常常表现出动态运动，例如振动。与静态场景相比，这对无人机的自适应控制和计算效率提出了更严格的要求。因此，本文提出了一种名为VisGeo-PipeTrack的伺服控制框架，利用几何约束使无人机能够跟踪动态管道。为实现高效的无人机定位，采用YOLOv5检测管道上的标签。基于这些检测到的标签，通过视觉几何约束推导位置，以实现精确定位。为应对跟踪控制挑战，提出了一种基于模型预测控制的实时校正自适应PID（MPC-RCAPID）控制器。该控制器采用递归最小二乘法进行实时模型估计，并结合滚动时域优化动态调整PID参数。在AirSim仿真器和Tello无人机平台上进行的实验验证了所提框架的有效性。与标准PID、分数阶PID、自适应PID和模糊PID的仿真对比表明，MPC-RCAPID实现了最短的调节时间（3.26 s）和最低的平均跟踪误差（3.52%）。在Tello平台上的物理实验中，与标准PID控制相比，MPC-RCAPID在三个测试维度上分别将平均跟踪误差降低了55.52%、26.72%和26.52%。这些结果表明，VisGeo-PipeTrack有助于在动态管道环境中实现高效的自主跟踪。

items.title_en: Natural-Language to Nav2: Operational Policies for Costmap-Based Navigation
items.title_zh: 自然语言到Nav2：基于代价地图导航的操作策略
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots support material transport in warehouses and industrial facilities, where navigation must adapt to changing operating conditions. Sensor observations reveal physical obstacles, but do not by themselves specify temporary access rules, route preferences, or exceptions known to operators. This paper presents a natural-language policy interface that brings this knowledge into ROS 2 Nav2. A local large language model converts instructions into JSON policies specifying destinations, spatial constraints, and temporal or event conditions. Deterministic checks govern mission acceptance, and three costmap adapters project accepted policies into the existing navigation stack without changing its planner or controller. On 150 researcher-authored English commands, four local models produce 107-142 correct accepted policies, compared with 44 for a rule-based parser, with 3-20 incorrect acceptances per model. Fault injection records rejection of eight endpoint/JSON faults and 29 validator-stage faults. Navigation experiments use correct task policies to evaluate keepouts, zone costs, person-dependent regions, and event-conditioned passage in simulation and on a TurtleBot3. For Tasks 1-3, mean travel times are 18.4-24.5% lower in simulation and 23.1-35.0% lower on the physical testbed than with the baseline lacking those policies. A native KeepoutFilter comparison and two-robot demonstrations examine basic keepout behavior and shared policy projection. The interface connects operator instructions to explicit navigation policies while retaining Nav2's planning and control components.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人支持仓库和工业设施中的物料运输，在这些场景中，导航必须适应不断变化的运行条件。传感器观测可揭示物理障碍，但其本身并不规定操作人员已知的临时通行规则、路径偏好或例外情况。本文提出一种自然语言策略接口，将这些知识引入ROS 2 Nav2。一个本地大语言模型将指令转换为JSON策略，指定目的地、空间约束以及时间或事件条件。确定性检查控制任务是否被接受，三个代价地图适配器将接受的策略投影到现有导航栈中，而不改变其规划器或控制器。在150条由研究人员编写的英文命令上，四个本地模型生成107-142条正确且被接受的策略，而基于规则的解析器为44条；每个模型有3-20条错误接受。故障注入记录了八个端点/JSON故障和29个验证器阶段故障被拒绝。导航实验使用正确的任务策略，在仿真和TurtleBot3上评估禁行区、区域代价、依赖人员的区域以及事件条件通行。对于任务1-3，与缺少这些策略的基线相比，仿真中的平均行驶时间降低18.4-24.5%，物理测试平台上的平均行驶时间降低23.1-35.0%。一项原生KeepoutFilter比较和两个机器人演示考察了基本禁行区行为和共享策略投影。该接口将操作人员指令连接到显式导航策略，同时保留Nav2的规划与控制组件。

items.title_en: Towards bio-inspired visual navigation: a neuromorphic navigation paradigm for MAVs
items.title_zh: 面向仿生视觉导航：一种面向微型飞行器的神经形态导航范式
items.abstract_en: Biological visual navigation achieves remarkable robustness at extremely low power, whereas frame-based robotic systems relying on artificial neural networks remain limited in both respects, particularly for energy-constrained micro aerial vehicles (MAVs) operating in complex environments. Inspired by the event-driven, sparse, and asynchronous principles of biological visual systems, neuromorphic sensing and computation provide a promising alternative for robust and energy-efficient navigation. In this paper, we propose the first end-to-end event-driven neuromorphic paradigm for MAV visual navigation in complex environments by integrating neuromorphic vision, spiking neural networks, and neuromorphic processors. The proposed method first extracts the environmental representation from event streams using a spiking perceptual representation module. This representation is fed into a spiking navigation module, where guidance learning and population coding enable efficient policy learning with few time steps. The navigation module then outputs a waypoint converted into executable trajectory points. Experiments show that the proposed neuromorphic method achieves navigation performance comparable to ANN-based methods while markedly reducing power consumption. The spiking perceptual module consumes only 19.57% of the power of its ANN counterpart, while the spiking navigation module deployed on Intel Loihi consumes only 12.37% of that required by its ANN counterpart running on NVIDIA Orin NX. Beyond prior neuromorphic systems focused mainly on relatively simple navigation subtasks, we demonstrate a complete neuromorphic visual navigation system spanning simulation and real-world deployment. Our results establish the feasibility of the neuromorphic paradigm for autonomous navigation and provide a bio-inspired pathway toward robust and low-power MAV navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 生物视觉导航以极低功耗实现了显著鲁棒性，而依赖人工神经网络的基于帧的机器人系统在这两方面仍受限，尤其是对于在复杂环境中运行的能量受限微型飞行器（MAV）。受生物视觉系统事件驱动、稀疏和异步原理的启发，神经形态感知与计算为鲁棒且节能的导航提供了一种有前景的替代方案。本文通过集成神经形态视觉、脉冲神经网络和神经形态处理器，提出了首个用于复杂环境中MAV视觉导航的端到端事件驱动神经形态范式。所提方法首先使用脉冲感知表征模块从事件流中提取环境表征。该表征被输入脉冲导航模块，在其中引导学习和群体编码能够在少量时间步内实现高效策略学习。随后，导航模块输出一个航点，并将其转换为可执行轨迹点。实验表明，所提神经形态方法在显著降低功耗的同时，实现了与基于ANN的方法相当的导航性能。脉冲感知模块的功耗仅为其ANN对应模块的19.57%，而部署在Intel Loihi上的脉冲导航模块的功耗仅为运行在NVIDIA Orin NX上的ANN对应模块所需功耗的12.37%。不同于以往主要关注相对简单导航子任务的神经形态系统，我们展示了一个涵盖仿真和真实世界部署的完整神经形态视觉导航系统。我们的结果确立了神经形态范式用于自主导航的可行性，并为鲁棒且低功耗的MAV导航提供了一条仿生路径。

items.title_en: DeRep: Learning Depth Representations for End-to-End Navigation in Cluttered Environments
items.title_zh: DeRep：面向杂乱环境中端到端导航的深度表示学习
items.abstract_en: End-to-end navigation in cluttered environments relies on compact visual representations to support collision avoidance and goal-directed motion. Existing methods typically learn these representations jointly with the policy or through observation reconstruction, which does not explicitly specify what information the representation should preserve. Moreover, they are usually evaluated with a single downstream policy learner, although the benefit of a representation may depend on how the policy is learned. It therefore remains unclear how different representation-learning objectives affect downstream navigation performance and robustness. This work proposes DeRep, a navigation-oriented representation-learning method that combines local bird's-eye-view reachability supervision with depth reconstruction. To compare representation objectives under controlled conditions, we pretrain encoders with a common architecture and freeze them during downstream learning. We evaluate the representations using a linear policy probe, flow-matching imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with PPO. DeRep achieves the lowest linear policy probe prediction error and outperforms reconstruction alone across all six tested PPO conditions. In imitation learning, both reachability-based objectives achieve higher mean success rates than reconstruction alone, with similar mean success rates between the reachability-only and joint objectives. These results demonstrate consistent benefits of incorporating reachability supervision into depth representation pretraining across different downstream learning methods and evaluation conditions. We further deploy the PPO policy with the frozen DeRep encoder in Gazebo and on a physical quadrotor without fine-tuning, demonstrating its capability for zero-shot sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfer.
items.abstract_zh: 杂乱环境中的端到端导航依赖于紧凑的视觉表示来支持避碰和目标导向运动。现有方法通常将这些表示与策略联合学习，或通过观测重建来学习，这并未明确指定表示应保留哪些信息。此外，它们通常仅用单一的下游策略学习器进行评估，尽管表示带来的收益可能取决于策略的学习方式。因此，不同表示学习目标如何影响下游导航性能和鲁棒性仍不清楚。本文提出 DeRep，一种面向导航的表示学习方法，将局部鸟瞰图可达性监督与深度重建相结合。为在受控条件下比较表示目标，我们使用相同架构预训练编码器，并在下游学习期间将其冻结。我们使用线性策略探针、流匹配模仿学习和 PPO 强化学习来评估这些表示。DeRep 取得最低的线性策略探针预测误差，并在所有六种测试的 PPO 条件下优于仅重建方法。在模仿学习中，两种基于可达性的目标均比仅重建取得更高的平均成功率，而仅可达性目标与联合目标的平均成功率相近。这些结果表明，在不同下游学习方法和评估条件下，将可达性监督纳入深度表示预训练具有一致的收益。我们进一步将带有冻结 DeRep 编码器的 PPO 策略部署到 Gazebo 和实体四旋翼上，无需微调，展示了其零样本 sim-to-sim 和 sim-to-real 迁移能力。

items.title_en: FASTFUNNELS: Agile Multi Robot Navigation in Narrow Spaces via Adaptive Dynamic Funnels
items.title_zh: FASTFUNNELS：通过自适应动态漏斗在狭窄空间中进行敏捷多机器人导航
items.abstract_en: We focus on the problem of high-speed multi-robot navigation in cluttered spaces with tight spatial constraints. A key challenge is balancing safety with agility, as existing methods often trade one for the other (slowing down near a bottleneck to avoid collisions versus failing to swerve in time at high speeds), especially for car-like systems. Our approach belongs to the family of formation control methods, in which Ackermann-steering agents coordinate while navigating tight spaces. However, current formation control techniques rely on rigid, pre-defined shapes and transitions that depend on initial conditions, the environment, and vehicle dynamics, and are impractical to maintain at high speeds. For example, agents passing through a small gap must first form a square, transform into a line using analytical equations, and then return to a square. In contrast, our approach is inspired by a droplet of water that continuously adapts its shape to the space it flows through without slowing down. We propose a hierarchical algorithm in which, at the high level, a reinforcement learning policy produces a dynamic, blob-like elliptical patch that morphs its shape in real time, squeezing, stretching, and orienting itself around obstacles and through tight spaces. At the low level, the robots are controlled via distributed model predictive control (DMPC) to stay inside the patch, which acts as a soft forcing function, while avoiding collisions with each other. We evaluate our approach, FastFunnels, on simulated F1TENTH racing cars across 14 scenarios with N=1 to N=6 robots, averaged over 20 trials each. FastFunnels achieves an 89% completion rate at 7.73 m/s, while all baselines either fail to complete the track or succeed only at very low speeds (0.07-1.79 m/s, about 40% completion rate).
items.abstract_zh: 我们关注在具有严格空间约束的杂乱空间中进行高速多机器人导航的问题。一个关键挑战是在安全性与敏捷性之间取得平衡，因为现有方法常常以牺牲一方换取另一方（在瓶颈附近减速以避免碰撞，对比在高速下无法及时转向），尤其是对于类车系统。我们的方法属于编队控制方法族，其中阿克曼转向智能体在狭窄空间中导航时进行协调。然而，当前的编队控制技术依赖刚性的预定义形状和过渡，这些形状和过渡取决于初始条件、环境和车辆动力学，并且难以在高速下维持。例如，通过小间隙的智能体必须首先形成正方形，使用解析方程变换为一条线，然后再恢复为正方形。相比之下，我们的方法受水滴启发，水滴会持续调整其形状以适应流经的空间而不减速。我们提出一种分层算法，其中在高层次，强化学习策略生成动态的、类斑块状椭圆补丁，该补丁实时变形其形状，在障碍物周围和狭窄空间中挤压、拉伸并调整自身方向。在低层次，机器人通过分布式模型预测控制（DMPC）进行控制，以保持在补丁内，该补丁充当软强制函数，同时避免彼此碰撞。我们在 14 个场景中，使用 N=1 至 N=6 个机器人的仿真 F1TENTH 赛车评估我们的方法 FastFunnels，每个场景平均 20 次试验。FastFunnels 在 7.73 m/s 下达到 89% 的完成率，而所有基线要么无法完成赛道，要么仅在极低速度（0.07-1.79 m/s，约 40% 完成率）下成功。

items.title_en: A Tightly Coupled Magnetic-Inertial SLAM System for Field Robots
items.title_zh: 面向野外机器人的紧耦合磁-惯性SLAM系统
items.abstract_en: Field robots operating in mines, tunnels, and disaster areas require reliable localization despite GNSS denial and degraded camera and LiDAR measurements caused by dust, smoke, or poor illumination. Missions involving both ground and aerial robots further motivate complementary sensing modalities that do not depend on visibility, preinstalled infrastructure, or wheel contact. This letter presents MISLAM, a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial simultaneous localization and mapping system using an IMU and a nine-magnetometer array, without relying on external odometry or platform-specific motion assumptions. The system combines the inertial navigation model with local polynomial magnetic-field models for short-term motion estimation and a global Gaussian process model for drift correction using an error-state Kalman filter. Offline evaluation on three indoor datasets collected with a handheld rig shows reductions in total endpoint closure error of 45.7% - 78.0% relative to magnetic-inertial odometry. Under poor illumination, MISLAM maintains tracking after visual-inertial odometry fails, achieving a horizontal closure error of 0.332 m, although vertical drift remains a limitation. These results support magnetic-inertial SLAM as a complementary localization modality for robotic sensor suites operating under degraded visual conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 在矿井、隧道和灾区作业的野外机器人，需要在GNSS拒止以及由粉尘、烟雾或光照不良导致的相机和LiDAR测量退化条件下仍具备可靠定位。同时涉及地面和空中机器人的任务进一步促使采用不依赖可见性、预装基础设施或车轮接触的互补传感模态。本文提出MISLAM，一种紧耦合磁-惯性同时定位与建图系统，使用IMU和九磁强计阵列，不依赖外部里程计或平台特定运动假设。该系统将惯性导航模型与用于短期运动估计的局部多项式磁场模型相结合，并使用误差状态卡尔曼滤波器结合全局高斯过程模型进行漂移校正。在三个使用手持装置采集的室内数据集上进行离线评估，结果显示总端点闭合误差相对于磁-惯性里程计降低45.7%–78.0%。在光照不良条件下，MISLAM在视觉-惯性里程计失效后仍保持跟踪，达到0.332 m的水平闭合误差，但垂直漂移仍是一个限制。这些结果支持将磁-惯性SLAM作为在视觉条件退化下运行的机器人传感器套件的补充定位模态。

items.title_en: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
items.title_zh: CoopUQ：基于不确定性感知协同预测的鲁棒多机器人社会导航
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast and scalable navigation decisions in constrained human-shared environments. However, directly extending single-robot approaches to multi-robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, where individual robots may overlook potential risks or make inaccurate predictions. Leveraging cooperation effectively for both prediction and navigation remains a major challenge. We propose CoopUQ, a multi-robot social navigation framework that bridges uncertainty-aware cooperative occupancy forecasting and robust decision making. CoopUQ predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain. This design enables the policy to adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts. Experimental results across multiple Unity3D-based simulation environments with both in-distribution and OOD settings, including diverse layouts, pedestrian densities, and rushing behavior, demonstrate improved prediction performance and safety over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes. Our code and videos are available at https://coopuq.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习使移动机器人能够在受限的人机共享环境中做出快速且可扩展的导航决策。然而，将单机器人方法直接扩展到多机器人场景时，往往无法确保安全性和效率，尤其是在遮挡和分布外（OOD）场景下，个体机器人可能忽视潜在风险或做出不准确的预测。如何有效利用协作来同时服务于预测和导航仍是一项重大挑战。我们提出 CoopUQ，一种多机器人社交导航框架，将不确定性感知的协同占据预测与鲁棒决策相连接。CoopUQ 通过跨机器人时空特征融合预测未来占据栅格地图，并进一步利用预测及其不确定性，通过约束多智能体强化学习引导策略，其中代价项惩罚穿越预测为被占据或高度不确定区域的导航。该设计使策略能够在分布偏移下调整其风险敏感性。在多个基于 Unity3D 的仿真环境中（包含分布内和 OOD 设置，涵盖多样布局、行人密度和匆忙行为）的实验结果表明，相较于代表性基线，预测性能与安全性均有所提升。真实机器人实验进一步证明了其在多种场景中的鲁棒性。我们的代码和视频见 https://coopuq.github.io/。

items.title_en: ECO-COMM: An Ultra Low-Latency Event Camera based Optical Communication System
items.title_zh: ECO-COMM：一种基于事件相机的超低时延光通信系统
items.abstract_en: Ultralow-latency communication is critical for emerging next-generation applications such as XR, real-time control, and distributed sensing. We present ECO-COMM, an event-camera-based optical communication system for ultra-low-latency device association and lightweight information exchange. By exploiting the asynchronous sensing and microsecond-level temporal resolution of event cameras, ECO-COMM captures high-frequency optical signals without frame-based acquisition delays. We identify and analyze key hardware-induced challenges in event-camera communication, including timestamp inconsistency, readout contention, trailing effects, and the inevitable refractory period, and develop hardware-aware mitigation techniques to address them. Focusing on a single transmitter-receiver optical link, ECO-COMM establishes the feasibility of practical ultra-low-latency event-camera communication using commercially available hardware.A prototype implementation using an eight-LED transmitter and an off-the-shelf event camera achieves device association within 15 microseconds, symbol latency as low as 100 microseconds, and end-to-end latency below 8 milliseconds for 32-byte payloads at 0.1% bit error rate. ECO-COMM establishes a practical and complementary communication paradigm for ultra-low-latency systems where responsiveness and temporal precision are paramount.
items.abstract_zh: 超低时延通信对XR、实时控制和分布式感知等新兴下一代应用至关重要。我们提出ECO-COMM，一种基于事件相机的光通信系统，用于超低时延的设备关联与轻量信息交换。利用事件相机的异步感知与微秒级时间分辨率，ECO-COMM无需基于帧的采集延迟即可捕获高频光信号。我们识别并分析了事件相机通信中若干关键的硬件诱发挑战，包括时间戳不一致、读出竞争、拖尾效应以及不可避免的不应期，并开发了硬件感知的缓解技术予以应对。聚焦单个发射机—接收机光链路，ECO-COMM验证了使用商用现成硬件实现实用超低时延事件相机通信的可行性。基于八个LED发射机与商用事件相机的原型实现，可在15微秒内完成设备关联，符号时延低至100微秒，并在0.1%误码率下实现32字节载荷低于8毫秒的端到端时延。ECO-COMM为以响应性和时间精度为优先的超低时延系统建立了一种实用且互补的通信范式。
items.highlight_zh: 用事件相机实现15微秒设备关联的超低时延光通信
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：XR、实时控制、分布式感知等应用对通信时延极其敏感，传统相机以固定帧率采集，天然带来帧周期等待，难以支撑微秒级的设备发现与轻量数据交换。

方法思路：作者提出 ECO-COMM，改用事件相机作为光接收端。事件相机不是逐帧曝光，而是每个像素在亮度变化时异步输出事件，因此具备微秒级时间分辨率，能直接捕捉高速闪烁的光信号，避免帧采集延迟。团队还系统梳理了这类方案中由硬件引入的四类难题：时间戳不一致、读出竞争、拖尾效应与不应期，并针对性地设计了硬件感知的补偿与调度技术。

实验结果：在单发射机—单接收机的链路原型上，使用八个 LED 组成的发射端与商用事件相机，系统可在 15 微秒内完成设备关联，符号时延低至 100 微秒；传输 32 字节载荷时，在 0.1% 误码率下端到端时延低于 8 毫秒。

为何重要：该工作证明仅用市面可得的硬件就能实现实用的超低时延光通信，并给出了一条与射频方案互补的技术路线。其价值在于把“感知式接收”引入通信领域，为对响应速度与时间精度要求极高的系统提供了新的设计范式，同时也为后续多链路、更高吞吐的研究标出了硬件瓶颈。

items.title_en: PVRA: A Pointwise Key-point Voting Framework for Robotic Assembly
items.title_zh: PVRA：面向机器人装配的逐点关键点投票框架
items.abstract_en: Modern computer vision has enabled partial autonomy in robotic assembly manipulation. However, performing autonomous manipulation of a progressive assembly demands a more specific set of skills, in addition to perceiving the objects. Through a comparative analysis of research in the associated domains, we deduce that object-centric perception must advance towards learning assembly dependencies to predict meaningful actionable outputs for autonomous assembly manipulation. Subsequently, we present a 3D keypoint-based modular learning framework to learn assembly dependencies to infer actionable outputs given a RGB-D input of an assembly scene. We train and evaluate our trained network on an assembly pose estimation dataset and compare it against object-centric baselines with an augmented set of metrics for progressive assemblies.
items.abstract_zh: 现代计算机视觉已在机器人装配操作中实现了部分自主。然而，对渐进式装配执行自主操作，除了感知物体外，还需要更特定的一组技能。通过对相关领域研究的比较分析，我们推断，以物体为中心的感知必须发展为学习装配依赖关系，以预测自主装配操作中有意义的可操作输出。随后，我们提出一个基于3D关键点的模块化学习框架，用于学习装配依赖关系，从而在给定装配场景RGB-D输入的情况下推断可操作输出。我们在一个装配位姿估计数据集上训练并评估所训练网络，并使用针对渐进式装配增强的指标集，将其与以物体为中心的基线进行比较。

items.title_en: Grip, Trace, Write: Force-Aware Imitation and Reinforcement Learning for High-DoF Robotic Handwriting
items.title_zh: Grip, Trace, Write：面向高自由度机器人手写的力感知模仿与强化学习
items.abstract_en: Most robotic handwriting rigidly mounts the pen and reduces writing to trajectory tracking. A freely held pen instead couples grasp stability, tip motion, and contact force. We present Grip, Trace, Write, a force-aware simulation environment and learning framework for high-DoF handwriting. A two-branch actor separates pen retention from arm-wrist writing while preserving their closed-loop coupling. Training learns a grasp controller, initializes writing from inverse-kinematics demonstrations by behavior cloning, and improves writing through reinforcement learning with rewards on ink, force, time, and retention. Across diverse tasks, the policy improves completion, precision, force regulation, and efficiency over behavior cloning and inverse kinematics, and generalizes without fine-tuning to unseen English and Chinese content. These results establish force-aware handwriting as a testbed for dexterous tool use.
items.abstract_zh: 大多数机器人手写将笔刚性固定，并将书写简化为轨迹跟踪。自由握持的笔则耦合了抓握稳定性、笔尖运动与接触力。我们提出 Grip, Trace, Write，一个面向高自由度手写的力感知仿真环境与学习框架。双分支 actor 将持笔与手臂-腕部书写分离，同时保留二者的闭环耦合。训练学习抓握控制器，通过行为克隆从逆运动学演示初始化书写，并通过强化学习改进书写，奖励基于墨迹、力、时间和持笔。在多样任务中，该策略在完成度、精度、力调节和效率上优于行为克隆与逆运动学，且无需微调即可泛化到未见过的英文和中文内容。这些结果将力感知手写确立为灵巧工具使用的测试平台。

items.title_en: Maze Runner: Autonomous Maze Navigation with Line-Based Localization and Control Barrier Functions
items.title_zh: Maze Runner：基于线定位与控制障碍函数的自主迷宫导航
items.abstract_en: Maze navigation requires localization from sparse, repetitive geometry, planning through narrow corridors, and control that stays safe when the estimate or the map is wrong. We present Maze Runner, an open autonomy stack in C++ and ROS 2 that addresses these needs end to end on a simulated Husarion ROSbot XL with a 2D LiDAR in Gazebo. Perception extracts wall lines from each scan with RANSAC and total least squares, with per-line uncertainty. The same line front end feeds two estimators: an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) that localizes against a line map built from the maze mesh, and an EKF SLAM variant that builds the line map online. Planning runs online on an inflated occupancy grid with A* plus line-of-sight shortcutting, or with a forward-only Hybrid A*. A nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (NMPC) tracks the plan while discrete-time Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) on world-frame LiDAR points keep the robot clear of walls and unmapped obstacles. The algorithms live in a ROS-free, unit-tested core library, and the whole stack builds and runs from a single reproducible environment. In simulation, the robot drives a 135 m route through the maze with 1.0 cm localization RMSE against the known map and 24 cm in SLAM mode, the planner returns a path in 6 ms, and the NMPC solves in 11.7 ms on average, never exceeding its 80 ms budget.
items.abstract_zh: 迷宫导航需要从稀疏、重复的几何结构中定位，在狭窄走廊中规划，并在估计或地图错误时保持安全的控制。我们提出 Maze Runner，一个基于 C++ 和 ROS 2 的开源自主软件栈，在 Gazebo 中使用带 2D LiDAR 的仿真 Husarion ROSbot XL 上端到端地满足这些需求。感知使用 RANSAC 和总体最小二乘从每次扫描中提取墙壁线，并给出每条线的不确定性。相同的线特征前端馈入两个估计器：一个扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF），其基于由迷宫网格构建的线地图进行定位；以及一个在线构建线地图的 EKF SLAM 变体。规划在膨胀占据栅格上在线运行，使用 A* 加视线捷径，或使用仅前向 Hybrid A*。非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC）跟踪该计划，同时在世界坐标系 LiDAR 点上的离散时间控制障碍函数（CBF）使机器人避开墙壁和未建图障碍物。这些算法位于一个不依赖 ROS、经过单元测试的核心库中，整个软件栈可在单一可复现环境中构建和运行。在仿真中，机器人沿穿过迷宫的 135 m 路线行驶，相对于已知地图的定位 RMSE 为 1.0 cm，在 SLAM 模式下为 24 cm；规划器在 6 ms 内返回路径，NMPC 平均在 11.7 ms 内求解，从未超过其 80 ms 预算。
items.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/alvgaona/maze-runner

items.title_en: GraspBench: Execution-Aware Cross-Robot Evaluation of 6-DoF Grasp Generation in MuJoCo
items.title_zh: GraspBench：在MuJoCo中对6自由度抓取生成进行执行感知的跨机器人评估
items.abstract_en: Modern 6-DoF grasp generators are often evaluated using grasp scores, dataset-level metrics, or single-robot demonstrations, yet proposal quality alone does not determine whether a grasp is executable by a particular robot. We present GraspBench, a controlled MuJoCo protocol for evaluating complete grasp-generation pipelines after robot-specific inverse-kinematics filtering, motion planning, and fixed approach-close-lift execution. GraspBench evaluates six configured pipelines across four robot embodiments, five diagnostic objects, and a structured tabletop pose grid, yielding 540 scenarios per method and 3,240 method-scenario evaluations in total. Missing outputs are conservatively counted as failures, and success follows the binary lift criterion produced by each method's execution runner. GraspGen achieves the highest overall success rate (73.1%), followed by EconomicGrasp (63.5%), while robot- and object-conditioned analyses reveal substantial variation across embodiments and object geometries. GPG produces the largest native candidate sets but achieves 44.3% success, indicating that proposal volume alone does not guarantee robot-executable grasps. Cluster-aware paired intervals support the principal method differences while not estimating repeated-execution uncertainty. The results characterize complete configured pipelines on fixed scenarios rather than intrinsic model quality or stochastic repeatability, showing that grasping performance depends jointly on the generator, robot embodiment, scene, and execution protocol.
items.abstract_zh: 现代6自由度抓取生成器通常使用抓取分数、数据集级指标或单机器人演示进行评估，但仅凭候选质量并不能决定某个抓取能否由特定机器人执行。我们提出GraspBench，一个受控的MuJoCo协议，用于在机器人特定逆运动学滤波、运动规划和固定的接近-闭合-抬升执行之后评估完整的抓取生成流水线。GraspBench在四种机器人形态、五个诊断物体和结构化桌面位姿网格上评估六条配置好的流水线，每种方法产生540个场景，总计3,240次方法-场景评估。缺失输出被保守地计为失败，成功与否遵循各方法执行运行器产生的二元抬升标准。GraspGen取得最高总体成功率（73.1%），其次是EconomicGrasp（63.5%）；而按机器人和物体条件的分析显示，不同形态和物体几何之间存在显著差异。GPG产生最大的原生候选集，但成功率为44.3%，表明仅靠候选数量并不能保证机器人可执行的抓取。聚类感知的配对区间支持主要方法差异，但不估计重复执行的不确定性。结果刻画的是固定场景下完整配置的流水线，而非内在模型质量或随机可重复性，表明抓取性能共同取决于生成器、机器人形态、场景和执行协议。

items.title_en: Fluidic Body: Swarm Robots as a Fluid Extension of the Hand
items.title_zh: Fluidic Body：群体机器人作为手部的流体延伸
items.abstract_en: Swarm robots have attracted growing interest as a physical interface for human--computer interaction, since a swarm can reshape its formation to fit the objects and surroundings it works with. For a human operator, however, adapting the swarm's behavior remains difficult. Most existing methods require the user to specify where the swarm should go, and they offer no intuitive way to change the collective's behavior as each task demands. We present Fluidic Body, a system that lets a person operate a swarm of fluid-imitating robots as an extension of the hand. The system places a virtual fluid between the hand and the swarm, and the user adapts the swarm's behavior to each task by changing the fluid's properties through simple hand movements. When the user opens the hand, the swarm becomes soft enough to deform and flow around obstacles. Closing the hand turns it into a hard, cohesive body that can push objects. We evaluated the controller's performance and its operability in two simulation experiments and one demonstration with physical robots. First, our controller handled both obstacle avoidance and object transportation better than an existing method that behaves the same way in every task. Second, in a VR user study, 17 participants completed the combined avoidance-and-transportation task faster and more reliably than with that method. They also reported a lower workload and a stronger sense of agency. Finally, this experience carried over to physical robots in a real-world demonstration (88 participants). These results suggest that treating a swarm as a fluid, a material people already understand, allows a robot swarm to work as a deformable extension of the human body.
items.abstract_zh: 群体机器人作为人机交互的物理接口正受到越来越多的关注，因为群体可以重塑其编队以适应其操作对象和周围环境。然而，对于人类操作者而言，调整群体行为仍然困难。大多数现有方法要求用户指定群体应前往何处，并且没有提供直观方式来根据每项任务需求改变集体行为。我们提出Fluidic Body，一个让用户将模仿流体的机器人群体作为手部延伸来操作的系统。该系统在手与群体之间放置虚拟流体，用户通过简单的手部动作改变流体属性，从而使群体行为适应每项任务。当用户张开手时，群体变得足够柔软，可以变形并绕过障碍物流动。握紧手时，它则变为坚硬、有内聚力的整体，可以推动物体。我们在两个仿真实验和一次物理机器人演示中评估了控制器的性能及其可操作性。首先，与在所有任务中行为相同的现有方法相比，我们的控制器在避障和物体运输两方面都处理得更好。其次，在一项VR用户研究中，17名参与者比使用该方法更快、更可靠地完成了避障与运输组合任务。他们还报告了更低的工作负荷和更强的能动感。最后，这一体验在真实世界演示（88名参与者）中延续到了物理机器人上。这些结果表明，将群体视为流体——一种人们已经理解的材料——可以使机器人群体作为人体可变形延伸来工作。

items.title_en: Rendering-Free Event Frame Simulation for Fast Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向自主机器人导航快速强化学习的无渲染事件帧仿真
items.abstract_en: Event cameras offer low latency, high dynamic range, and milliwatt-level power consumption, making them ideal for agile robots such as tiny drones navigating through cluttered environments. However, existing simulators generally render photorealistic images before converting them into events, making large-scale reinforcement learning prohibitively slow. We propose an analytic event simulator that exploits what event cameras fundamentally measure - moving contrast edges - to synthesize event streams directly from scene geometry and ego-motion without visual rendering. Our simulator generates a 64x64 event observation in 17 microseconds on a single GPU - over 400x faster than a state-of-the-art rendering pipeline - enabling end-to-end reinforcement learning for goal-directed obstacle avoidance to converge in under 30 minutes - three orders of magnitude faster than training on rendered events. Policies transfer zero-shot to physically based event simulations (ray-traced Isaac Sim). Our policy reaches 83% success in cluttered courses unseen during training (mid-difficulty, traversability probability approx. 0.57), at 2.4 m/s average goal velocity, and retains 70% in a simulated texture-dense indoor hall. Furthermore, we quantized the policy to a 1.2 MB int8 network running fully onboard a 56-gram Crazyflie equipped with a Prophesee GenX320 event camera and an OpenMV N6 microcontroller board. Without any fine-tuning, external processing, or positioning, the policy achieves an average success rate of 82% (5/5, 5/6, 4/6 flights) across three real-world obstacle courses of increasing difficulty. Code: https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机具有低延迟、高动态范围和毫瓦级功耗，使其成为敏捷机器人（例如在杂乱环境中导航的微型无人机）的理想选择。然而，现有仿真器通常先渲染照片级真实图像，再将其转换为事件，这使得大规模强化学习慢得令人难以承受。我们提出一种解析事件仿真器，利用事件相机本质上测量的内容——运动对比度边缘——直接从场景几何和自运动合成事件流，而无需视觉渲染。我们的仿真器在单块 GPU 上 17 微秒内生成 64x64 事件观测——比最先进的渲染流水线快 400 倍以上——使面向目标导向避障的端到端强化学习能在 30 分钟内收敛——比在渲染事件上训练快三个数量级。策略可零样本迁移到基于物理的事件仿真（光线追踪 Isaac Sim）。我们的策略在训练中未见过的杂乱赛道（中等难度，可通行概率约 0.57）达到 83% 成功率，平均目标速度为 2.4 m/s，并在模拟的纹理密集室内大厅中保持 70%。此外，我们将策略量化为 1.2 MB 的 int8 网络，完全在搭载 Prophesee GenX320 事件相机和 OpenMV N6 微控制器板的 56 克 Crazyflie 上机载运行。在无需任何微调、外部处理或定位的情况下，该策略在三条难度递增的真实世界障碍赛道中平均成功率达到 82%（5/5、5/6、4/6 次飞行）。代码：https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav

items.title_en: Real-Time Disturbance-Aware Koopman Model Predictive Control for Quadrotors in Spatially Varying Winds
items.title_zh: 面向空间变化风场中四旋翼的实时扰动感知Koopman模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Reliable quadrotor flight in disturbed environments requires predictive models that remain accurate as unmodeled aerodynamic effects change during deployment. We introduce a disturbance-aware Koopman Control Family (DA-KCF) framework that preserves an offline-identified nominal model while learning only a disturbance-induced correction online. A reference-dependent KCF is first learned from simulation data and calibrated using limited hardware data. During deployment, the nominal KCF remains fixed while a lightweight residual ensemble learns a low-dimensional disturbance correction from causal state-command-state transitions. The Adaptive DA-KCF model is incorporated into MPC, where disturbance corrections are evaluated along the prediction horizon to optimize position and yaw references sent to the onboard stabilizing controller. Hardware experiments on a nano-quadrotor under uniform wind and a spatially varying wake demonstrate that online adaptation improves multi-step prediction and trajectory tracking as disturbance-induced model mismatch increases, while satisfying real-time control requirements.
items.abstract_zh: 在受扰环境中实现可靠的四旋翼飞行，需要预测模型在部署过程中未建模气动效应发生变化时仍保持准确。我们提出一种扰动感知Koopman控制族（DA-KCF）框架，该框架保留离线辨识的标称模型，仅在线学习由扰动引起的修正。首先从仿真数据中学习依赖参考轨迹的KCF，并利用有限的硬件数据进行校准。部署期间，标称KCF保持固定，而一个轻量级残差集成模型从因果的状态—指令—状态转移中学习低维扰动修正。将自适应DA-KCF模型纳入MPC，在预测时域上评估扰动修正，以优化发送给机载稳定控制器的位置与偏航参考。在均匀风和空间变化尾流下对纳米四旋翼进行的硬件实验表明，随着扰动引起的模型失配增大，在线自适应可改善多步预测和轨迹跟踪，同时满足实时控制要求。

items.title_en: Onboard Lightweight LLM Reasoning for Human-Aware Safe UAV Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向人体感知安全无人机导航的机载轻量级LLM推理
items.abstract_en: Aerial robots operating near people must treat a pedestrian, a parked car, and a wall differently, yet conventional perception--planning stacks reduce all of them to occupied geometry---a \emph{human-aware safety gap} in which category-specific clearance is unavailable to the planner and temporary occlusions remove pedestrian-specific constraints from its map. We present a modular, fully onboard pipeline that closes this gap by turning visual observations into context-dependent safety constraints for real-time UAV navigation. A shared BLIP encoder drives scene captioning and text-conditioned segmentation, which is fused with depth to localize obstacles in 3D. Obstacle-specific risk is inferred by a lightweight LLM (Qwen-2.5-0.5B) stabilized with retrieval-augmented generation and grammar-constrained decoding that restricts its output to a planner-compatible JSON schema. The LLM reasons once per object category rather than per frame: its verdicts are cached per class, so previously seen categories are resolved without inference and new ones trigger a fresh retrieval-grounded query; detections are additionally given persistent identities and held in the map across occlusions. The perception pipeline runs at 10\,Hz on a Jetson Orin NX, while fallback LLM queries take approximately 0.8\,s and remain off the control-critical path. In Gazebo, low-altitude urban navigation among pedestrians and vehicles shows a roughly $3\times$ reduction in collision events over a geometric planner, and semantics-aware landing among moving actors raises success from 34\% to 96\%. The 224-pixel encoder input limits reliable small-object perception at range; conservative pedestrian margins and short-term persistence mitigate this limitation during navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 在人员附近运行的空中机器人必须区别对待行人、停放车辆和墙体，然而传统感知—规划流程将所有这些都简化为占据几何——这是一种\emph{人体感知安全缺口}：规划器无法获得类别特定的安全间距，且临时遮挡会将行人特定约束从其地图中移除。我们提出一种模块化、完全机载的流程，通过将视觉观测转化为面向实时无人机导航的上下文相关安全约束来弥补这一缺口。共享的BLIP编码器驱动场景描述和文本条件分割，并与深度信息融合以在3D中定位障碍物。障碍物特定风险由轻量级LLM（Qwen-2.5-0.5B）推断，并通过检索增强生成和语法约束解码进行稳定，后者将其输出限制为规划器兼容的JSON模式。LLM按对象类别而非按帧进行推理：其判定按类别缓存，因此先前见过的类别无需推理即可解析，新类别则触发新的基于检索的查询；检测结果还被赋予持久身份，并在遮挡期间保留在地图中。感知流程在Jetson Orin NX上以10\,Hz运行，而回退LLM查询耗时约0.8\,s，且不处于控制关键路径上。在Gazebo中，行人与车辆间的低空城市导航显示，与几何规划器相比碰撞事件约减少$3\times$，而在移动参与者之间进行语义感知着陆将成功率从34%提高到96%。224像素的编码器输入限制了远距离小目标的可靠感知；保守的行人间距和短期持续性可在导航期间缓解这一限制。

items.title_en: LIN-SLAM: Lightweight LiDAR--Inertial Neural SLAM for Real-Time Onboard Navigation
items.title_zh: LIN-SLAM：用于实时机载导航的轻量级激光雷达-惯性神经SLAM
items.abstract_en: Geometric light detection and ranging (LiDAR)--inertial simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) provides efficient state estimation but lacks the continuous map representation and global refinement capabilities of neural implicit SLAM, while neural implicit methods remain computationally expensive. We propose Lightweight LiDAR--Inertial Neural SLAM (LIN-SLAM), a hybrid method that couples high-rate geometric LiDAR--inertial estimation with neural implicit tracking, continual mapping, and global refinement for accurate real-time onboard SLAM. Experiments on twelve representative sequences from three datasets spanning 32-, 64-, and 128-channel LiDAR configurations show that LIN-SLAM achieves the lowest overall mean absolute trajectory error (ATE) among the evaluated state-of-the-art geometric and neural implicit methods, while substantially reducing runtime compared with existing neural implicit SLAM methods. On a Unitree Go2 equipped with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX and a 16-channel LiDAR, LIN-SLAM sustains real-time localization and neural mapping over a 1.47-km indoor trajectory through challenging repetitive corridor environments, with an endpoint closure error of only 0.141~m. To the best of our knowledge, LIN-SLAM is the first LiDAR--inertial SLAM system with a neural implicit backend to achieve real-time online operation on a mobile robotic platform while maintaining state-of-the-art localization accuracy. The code will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 几何激光雷达（LiDAR）-惯性同时定位与建图（SLAM）提供高效的状态估计，但缺乏神经隐式SLAM的连续地图表示和全局优化能力，而神经隐式方法仍然计算开销高昂。我们提出轻量级激光雷达-惯性神经SLAM（LIN-SLAM），一种混合方法，将高频率几何LiDAR-惯性估计与神经隐式跟踪、持续建图和全局优化相耦合，以实现准确的实时机载SLAM。在来自三个数据集、涵盖32、64和128线LiDAR配置的十二条代表性序列上的实验表明，在所评估的先进几何方法和神经隐式方法中，LIN-SLAM取得最低的总体平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE），同时与现有神经隐式SLAM方法相比大幅减少运行时间。在配备NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX和16线LiDAR的Unitree Go2上，LIN-SLAM在具有挑战性的重复走廊环境中，于1.47 km的室内轨迹上持续进行实时定位和神经建图，端点闭合误差仅为0.141 m。据我们所知，LIN-SLAM是首个在移动机器人平台上实现实时在线运行、同时保持先进定位精度的具有神经隐式后端的LiDAR-惯性SLAM系统。代码将在论文被接收后发布。
