items.title_en: WRAP: Fixtureless Wrench-aware Multi-Robot Assembly Planning
items.title_zh: WRAP：无夹具、力旋量感知的多机器人装配规划
items.abstract_en: Assembly using robots often requires specially designed fixtures, or relies on top-down only assembly strategies. Using multiple robots, we can avoid using fixtures and make robotic assembly more flexible. Planning assembly sequences for multiple robots is challenging due to the high number of possible task assignments and orders. In addition, we need to reason over forces that occur during the assembly process, e.g., to decide if multiple robots are required for support, or if external support such as a table should be used. We present Wrap, a multi-robot assembly planner for multi-part assemblies, given the inter-part ordering-dependencies, the part meshes, and their initial state. We formulate a linear program to reason about valid grasps for supporting the forces that occur during assembly. The search leverages the assembly sequence, and greedily finds a feasible solution per assembly step by computing a heuristic via a cheap backwards search, and using the heuristic in the more expensive forward search. We then solve the multi-robot, multi-goal motion planning problem, and for execution, we split the plan into contact-rich assembly skills, and free space motion. We benchmark the planner on a variety of multi-part assemblies, and apply the planner to groups of robots differing in size and kinematics. We validate the work both in a physics simulation, and in real. Videos and code are available at https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap.
items.abstract_zh: 使用机器人进行装配通常需要专门设计的夹具，或依赖仅自顶向下的装配策略。使用多机器人，我们可以避免使用夹具，并使机器人装配更加灵活。为多机器人规划装配序列具有挑战性，因为可能的任务分配和顺序数量庞大。此外，我们需要对装配过程中出现的力进行推理，例如决定是否需要多个机器人提供支撑，或是否应使用桌子等外部支撑。我们提出 Wrap，一种用于多零件装配的多机器人装配规划器，给定零件间顺序依赖关系、零件网格及其初始状态。我们构建一个线性规划来推理用于支撑装配过程中所产生力的有效抓取。搜索利用装配序列，并通过廉价的后向搜索计算启发式，再在更昂贵的前向搜索中使用该启发式，从而为每个装配步骤贪心地找到可行解。随后我们求解多机器人、多目标运动规划问题；在执行时，我们将计划分解为富接触装配技能和自由空间运动。我们在多种多零件装配上对规划器进行基准测试，并将其应用于尺寸和运动学不同的机器人群体。我们在物理仿真和真实环境中验证了该工作。视频和代码见 https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap。
items.comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables

items.title_en: Backward Layout Search for Sequence-Constrained Robotic Assembly
items.title_zh: 面向序列约束机器人装配的后向布局搜索
items.abstract_en: Robotic assembly layout planning must determine the assembly site and the initial pose of each part while ensuring collision-free execution of a prescribed assembly sequence. This problem is challenging because the obstacle environment changes after each assembly step, and unassembled parts re maining in the workspace may block robot motions. We observe that the feasibility of each assembly step depends only on the initial poses of the current and later-assembled parts. Based on this dependency, we propose Backward Layout Search (BLS), which assigns initial part poses in reverse assembly order. Each expansion performs geometric, kinematic, grasp, and prescribed-motion checks, while collision masks and candidate set filtering remove infeasible initial part pose candidates. Promising partial layouts are retained through beam selection, and complete layouts are validated by full motion planning in forward assembly order. Experiments on five assembly models show that BLS produces collision-free executable layouts and reduces step evaluations and search time compared with a matched forward search.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人装配布局规划必须确定装配站点以及每个零件的初始位姿，同时确保给定装配序列的无碰撞执行。该问题具有挑战性，因为障碍物环境在每个装配步骤后都会变化，且工作空间中残留的未装配零件可能阻挡机器人运动。我们观察到，每个装配步骤的可行性仅取决于当前及后续装配零件的初始位姿。基于这一依赖关系，我们提出后向布局搜索（Backward Layout Search, BLS），按逆装配顺序分配零件初始位姿。每次扩展执行几何、运动学、抓取和规定运动检查，同时碰撞掩码和候选集过滤移除不可行的初始零件位姿候选。有前景的部分布局通过束选择保留，完整布局则通过按正向装配顺序的完整运动规划进行验证。在五个装配模型上的实验表明，BLS生成无碰撞可执行布局，并且与匹配的前向搜索相比减少了步骤评估次数和搜索时间。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation
items.title_en: ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation using Concept Vectors
items.title_zh: ConceptPose：使用概念向量的免训练零样本物体位姿估计
items.abstract_en: Object pose estimation is a fundamental task in computer vision and robotics, yet most methods require extensive, dataset-specific training. Concurrently, large-scale vision language models show remarkable zero-shot capabilities. In this work, we bridge these two worlds by introducing ConceptPose, a framework for object pose estimation that is both training-free and model-free. ConceptPose leverages a vision-language-model (VLM) to create open-vocabulary 3D concept maps, where each point is tagged with a concept vector derived from saliency maps. By establishing robust 3D-3D correspondences across concept maps, our approach allows precise estimation of 6DoF relative pose. Without any object or dataset-specific training, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on common zero shot relative pose estimation benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by a relative 62% in average ADD(-S) score, including methods that utilize extensive dataset-specific training.
items.abstract_zh: 物体位姿估计是计算机视觉和机器人学的基础任务，但大多数方法需要大量数据集特定训练。同时，大规模视觉语言模型展现出显著的零样本能力。在本工作中，我们通过引入ConceptPose来连接这两个世界，这是一个既免训练又免模型的物体位姿估计框架。ConceptPose利用视觉语言模型（VLM）创建开放词汇3D概念图，其中每个点都标记有由显著图得到的概念向量。通过在概念图之间建立稳健的3D-3D对应关系，我们的方法可以精确估计6DoF相对位姿。无需任何针对物体或数据集的训练，我们的方法在常见的零样本相对位姿估计基准上取得最先进结果，平均ADD(-S)分数相对最强基线提升62%，包括使用大量数据集特定训练的方法。
items.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026

rm.usage: 可用于重装机器人在没有大量标注数据的情况下估计科技核心、能量单元或待装配部件的6DoF相对位姿，思路是把VLM显著图生成的开词汇3D概念图用于3D-3D对应，从而支持免训练的视觉伺服初始化。但方案依赖VLM推理，机载算力与装配所需毫米级精度都需实测；不能把概念图匹配等同于稳定的装配位姿输出。

items.title_en: ECO-ID: Event-Camera based Optical System for Secure Multi-User Ultra-Low Latency Identification
items.title_zh: ECO-ID：基于事件相机的多用户超低时延安全光学识别系统
items.abstract_en: Time-critical interactive systems increasingly require ultra-low-latency device identification for multiple users, yet prevailing approaches such as passwords, QR codes, and RFID/NFC are constrained by human input, frame-based sensing, or near-contact range. This paper presents ECO-ID, an event-camera-based optical system for multi-user, ultra-low-latency identification over visible light communication (VLC). Leveraging microsecond-resolution, asynchronous observations of brightness transitions, ECO-ID employs a spatiotemporal coding design: disjoint LED subsets provide spatial separation among users, while user-specific timing delays encode identities without inter-user synchronization. The optical channel and event-driven sensing reduce full-scene capture relative to frame cameras and limit the RF attack surface, while enabling rapid token verification with freshness and replay protection. We implement a prototype and demonstrate that ECO-ID can practically achieve approximately 99.8\% localization and 98.7\% identification with 0.64 ms mean latency, while theoretically supporting identification at the scale of tens of concurrent users. Overall, ECO-ID provides a fast, privacy-conscious, and security-aware alternative for scalable multi-user identification in time-critical interactive environments.
items.abstract_zh: 时间敏感的交互系统日益需要面向多用户的超低时延设备识别，而密码、二维码、RFID/NFC等主流方式受限于人工输入、帧式传感或近距接触。本文提出ECO-ID，一种基于事件相机、通过可见光通信（VLC）实现多用户超低时延识别的光学系统。它利用事件相机对亮度跃变微秒级、异步的观测能力，采用时空编码设计：互不相交的LED子集在空间上区分不同用户，用户特定的时延则在不需用户间同步的情况下编码身份。光学信道与事件驱动传感减少了对整幅场景的采集，也缩小了射频攻击面，同时支持带新鲜性校验与重放保护的快速凭证验证。原型实验表明，ECO-ID 可实现约99.8%的定位率与98.7%的识别率，平均时延 0.64 ms，理论上可支持数十个并发用户。
items.highlight_zh: 事件相机+LED时空编码，实现0.64毫秒多用户光学身份识别
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：在需要即时响应的交互场景（如多人同时操作的大屏、AR/VR、门禁）中，设备要快速认出“现在是谁在操作”。密码要人输入、二维码要人举起来对准、RFID/NFC则要求贴近，且基于帧的摄像头天生有延迟。作者要解决的是：如何让多个用户几乎无感地、在毫秒级被识别出来。

二、用了什么方法：用事件相机作为接收器。事件相机不像普通摄像头那样逐帧曝光，而是只在像素亮度发生变化时异步输出事件，时间分辨率达微秒级。作者设计了时空联合编码：空间上，给不同用户分配互不重叠的LED子集，靠位置区分人；时间上，给每个用户设定专属的发光时延，靠“节奏”编码身份，而且不需要用户之间做时钟同步。安全方面，光信道不易被远程窃听，事件相机只记录变化而非整幅画面，也缩小了射频攻击面，并配合新鲜性校验与防重放机制。

三、有什么结果：作者做出原型系统，实测定位准确率约99.8%、身份识别准确率约98.7%，平均时延仅0.64 ms；分析表明该方案在原理上可扩展到数十个并发用户。

四、为何重要：它给出了一条不依赖人工操作、不依赖射频、且兼顾隐私与安全的识别路径，适用于对延迟极敏感的多人交互场景，是对二维码与RFID等方案的有力补充。

items.title_en: Channel Modeling and LED Spot Detection for Dense Image-Sensor Visible Light Communication
items.title_zh: 密集图像传感器可见光通信的信道建模与LED光斑检测
items.abstract_en: High-density LED arrays enable high-speed transmission in image-sensor-based visible-light communication (VLC) systems. However, when optical spots become blurred and spatially overlapped due to focal shift, resolution limitations, or interference, severe inter-symbol interference (ISI) occurs, significantly degrading decoding performance. Furthermore, radial distortion introduces geometric deformation of the LED grid, while vignetting leads to incomplete and asymmetric spot shapes at the periphery, both of which further hinder reliable signal detection. Existing methods mitigate ISI by reducing LED transmission signaling density. This paper proposes a robust decoding framework that maintains full LED signaling density. We introduce a pilot-aided geometric recognition method that uses a PSF-constrained Hough transform and circle-center alignment refinement. \textbf{In addition, radial distortion correction and vignetting-aware compensation are incorporated to restore geometric consistency and suppress edge-related detection errors.} By leveraging prior structural knowledge from pilot frames, the system effectively separates overlapping LED signals under severe optical distortion. Experimental results on a real-world VLC testbed confirm that the proposed method achieves superior decoding accuracy and throughput compared to conventional Hough-based and low-density baseline methods. The results highlight its potential for high-efficiency VLC applications in interference-prone environments.
items.abstract_zh: 高密度LED阵列可在基于图像传感器的可见光通信（VLC）系统中实现高速传输。但当离焦、分辨率受限或干扰导致光斑模糊并空间重叠时，会产生严重的符号间干扰（ISI），显著降低解码性能。此外，径向畸变使LED网格发生几何形变，渐晕则造成边缘光斑形状不完整且不对称，这些都进一步妨碍可靠检测。现有方法通过降低LED发送密度来缓解ISI。本文提出一种在保持全LED发送密度下仍能稳健解码的框架，引入基于导频的几何识别方法，采用受点扩散函数（PSF）约束的Hough变换与圆心对齐精修，并结合径向畸变校正与渐晕感知补偿，以恢复几何一致性、抑制边缘检测误差。借助导频帧提供的先验结构知识，系统可在严重光学畸变下分离重叠的LED信号。在真实VLC测试平台上的实验表明，该方法相较传统Hough类方法与低密度基线在解码准确率和吞吐量上均有优势。
items.highlight_zh: 保持全LED密度，用PSF约束Hough变换分离重叠光斑
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：用手机或工业相机拍摄LED阵列来做可见光通信时，LED越密、速率越高，但实际拍摄中光斑会因离焦、分辨率不足或相邻干扰而变糊、互相重叠，造成严重的符号间干扰（ISI）。同时镜头的径向畸变会把本来规整的LED网格“拉弯”，渐晕又让画面边缘的光斑变暗、残缺、不对称，这些都会让解码出错。以往的做法是少开一些LED（降低发送密度）来换取清晰度，代价是速率下降。

二、用了什么方法：作者坚持不降低LED密度，转而用“先验知识”来解题。系统先发送导频帧，让接收端知道LED阵列本应长什么样；再据此做几何识别——把光斑的形状特性（点扩散函数，PSF）作为约束嵌入Hough变换来检测圆斑，并用圆心对齐做亚像素级精修；同时估计并校正径向畸变、对渐晕做感知补偿，把边缘区域“拉回”正常形态。有了这些几何约束，即使光斑严重重叠也能被分离出来。

三、有什么结果：在真实VLC测试平台上，该方法的解码准确率和吞吐量都优于传统基于Hough变换的方法以及低密度发送的基线方案，说明“不牺牲密度也能可靠解码”是可行的。

四、为何重要：它把限制高速图像传感器VLC的瓶颈从“硬件光学缺陷”转化为“可利用的先验信息”，在干扰严重、镜头质量一般的现实环境中依然能跑高吞吐，为密集LED阵列VLC的实用化扫清了一大障碍。

items.title_en: Autonomous Whole-body Loco-manipulation Using a Snake Robot
items.title_zh: 使用蛇形机器人的自主全身移动操作
items.abstract_en: Snake robots can leverage their hyper-redundant morphology for both locomotion and manipulation through distributed body contact but whole-body loco-manipulation is particularly challenging since the entire body serves simultaneously as propulsive mechanism and manipulation tool Prior work on wheeled legged and snake robot platforms has decoupled these functions through dedicated appendages body segmentation or grippers We present closed-loop loco-manipulation with our snake robot COBRA without this distinction such that any part of the body may make contact We develop a contact-implicit dynamic model unifying robot-ground robot-object and object-ground interactions within a Moreau-Jean time-stepping framework and formulate a trajectory optimization over the full-order dynamics guided by a geometric planner and nominal proportional controller to autonomously push an object to a goal location during sidewinding We validate the planner and controller on hardware across varied configurations and present simulation results for a simplified trajectory optimization that resolves robot-object and object-ground contacts
items.abstract_zh: 蛇形机器人可以通过分布式身体接触利用其超冗余形态进行移动和操作，但全身移动操作尤其具有挑战性，因为整个身体同时充当推进机构和操作工具。先前关于轮式、腿式和蛇形机器人平台的工作通过专用附肢、身体分割或夹爪将这些功能解耦。我们展示了使用我们的蛇形机器人 COBRA 的闭环移动操作，无需这种区分，因此身体的任何部分都可以进行接触。我们开发了一个接触隐式动力学模型，在 Moreau-Jean 时间步进框架内统一机器人-地面、机器人-物体和物体-地面交互，并构建了全阶动力学上的轨迹优化，由几何规划器和标称比例控制器引导，以在侧行（sidewinding）过程中自主将物体推到目标位置。我们在硬件上跨多种配置验证了规划器和控制器，并给出了简化轨迹优化的仿真结果，该优化处理机器人-物体和物体-地面接触。

items.title_en: Certified Zonotopic Reachability Analysis for Trajectory Tracking on Lie Groups
items.title_zh: 李群上轨迹跟踪的经认证环带可达性分析
items.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles track planned trajectories close to obstacles. Unknown disturbances make them deviate from these trajectories. With a bound on the tracking error that disturbances can cause, a planned trajectory can be certified as safe before execution. Existing set-based methods bound the tracking error by one invariant ellipsoid for the whole trajectory or by intervals, which are both conservative. For aerial and space vehicles, the tracking error evolves on a matrix Lie group with nonlinear dynamics. However, for group-affine systems, the error dynamics are linear in Lie algebra coordinates when the vehicle receives the inputs of the reference. The control input and the disturbance enter through the inverse right Jacobian, a matrix that depends on the error. We propagate the linear part of the error dynamics with zonotopes and enclose the effect of the inverse right Jacobian on the disturbance in closed form. The resulting tubes are tight and provably contain all reachable tracking errors in continuous time. When some error components have no input, the inverse right Jacobian leaves unmatched nonlinear terms in the closed loop. None of the tested methods certifies such a closed loop. Hybrid coordinates make these terms matched, so that our controller cancels every nonlinear term that does not contain the disturbance. Our tubes give tighter bounds than the ellipsoid method in simulations of a planar aircraft and a fully actuated multirotor and in real flights of a quadrotor, where the tube contains every measured attitude error. Under larger disturbances and the same feedback gain, the ellipsoid method yields no valid ellipsoid, whereas our tubes remain valid.
items.abstract_zh: 自主载具在障碍物附近跟踪规划轨迹。未知扰动使其偏离这些轨迹。若对扰动可能造成的跟踪误差给出界限，则可在执行前认证规划轨迹是安全的。现有基于集合的方法用整条轨迹上的一个不变椭球或用区间来界定跟踪误差，二者都较为保守。对于空中和航天载具，跟踪误差在具有非线性动力学的矩阵李群上演化。然而，对于群仿射系统，当载具接收参考输入时，误差动力学在李代数坐标中是线性的。控制输入和扰动通过逆右雅可比矩阵进入，该矩阵依赖于误差。我们用环带传播误差动力学的线性部分，并以闭式形式包络逆右雅可比对扰动的影响。所得管道是紧的，并可证明在连续时间中包含所有可达跟踪误差。当某些误差分量没有输入时，逆右雅可比在闭环中留下未匹配的非线性项。所测试的方法均无法认证这样的闭环。混合坐标使这些项匹配，从而使我们的控制器抵消所有不含扰动的非线性项。在平面飞行器和全驱动多旋翼的仿真以及四旋翼的真实飞行中，我们的管道比椭球方法给出更紧的界限，其中管道包含每个测得姿态误差。在更大扰动和相同反馈增益下，椭球方法无法给出有效椭球，而我们的管道仍然有效。

items.title_en: SAM-VTP: Video Memory and Measured Geometry for Continuous Traversability Segmentation
items.title_zh: SAM-VTP：用于连续可通行性分割的视频记忆与实测几何
items.abstract_en: Traversability prediction is a core component of autonomous navigation, yet most vision-based methods operate frame-wise and produce temporally inconsistent predictions. We present SAM-VTP (Video Traversability Prediction), which fine-tunes SAM2's video memory pathway for dense, prompt-free traversability segmentation, conditioning each frame on a persistent memory of prior observations. Rather than inferring terrain geometry from appearance, we measure it: slope, roughness and height are computed from depth and fused into the image features. We also introduce an offline continuous supervision pipeline that generates dense per-pixel traversability targets in [0,1] from depth-derived geometry and semantic priors, requiring no robot deployment and no per-pixel annotation, capturing conditional feasibility that binary labels cannot represent. On TartanGround, a large-scale synthetic ground-robot dataset, SAM-VTP improves fuzzy Jaccard from 0.908 to 0.924 and binary IoU from 0.854 to 0.886 over SAM-TP, a frame-wise SAM2 baseline, against a seed-to-seed spread below 0.001, and cuts frame-to-frame flicker by 31%. In closed-loop trials at two field sites, driving the same planner and controller, the baseline's dropouts leave the planner without a feasible path 3.3x more often on a paved course and 6.9x on rough ground, while SAM-VTP runs at 21.4 FPS on the Orin Nano the robot carries.
items.abstract_zh: 可通行性预测是自主导航的核心组成部分，然而大多数基于视觉的方法逐帧运行并产生时间上不一致的预测。我们提出SAM-VTP（视频可通行性预测），它微调SAM2的视频记忆通路，用于稠密、无提示的可通行性分割，使每一帧以先前观测的持久记忆为条件。我们不从外观推断地形几何，而是测量它：坡度、粗糙度和高度由深度计算，并融合到图像特征中。我们还引入一种离线连续监督流水线，从深度导出几何和语义先验生成[0,1]范围内的稠密逐像素可通行性目标，无需机器人部署和逐像素标注，捕捉二值标签无法表示的条件可行性。在TartanGround这一大规模合成地面机器人数据集上，SAM-VTP相较于逐帧SAM2基线SAM-TP，将模糊Jaccard从0.908提高到0.924，将二值IoU从0.854提高到0.886，而种子间波动低于0.001，并将帧间闪烁减少31%。在两个野外场地的闭环试验中，驱动相同的规划器和控制器，基线的中断使规划器没有可行路径的情况在铺装路面上多3.3倍，在崎岖地面上多6.9倍，而SAM-VTP在机器人携带的Orin Nano上以21.4 FPS运行。

items.title_en: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
items.title_zh: DPGS-SLAM：面向动态视觉感知的扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出DPGS-SLAM（扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅SLAM），用于包含动态对象的环境中的稠密建图。动态观测会污染视觉SLAM（同时定位与建图）中的相机跟踪和场景重建。尽管3DGS（三维高斯泼溅）能够实现高效稠密建图，但现有3DGS-SLAM系统在动态对象违反其底层静态场景假设时可能表现出不稳定性。排除动态观测可以减少其对跟踪和建图的影响，但可能使被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束较弱。我们提出的DPGS-SLAM是一种单目RGB SLAM框架，通过异步扩散式背景补全和来源感知高斯建图，支持对观测不足的静态背景进行临时表示。动态区域通过基于光流的运动发现和SAM2（segment anything model 2）的时间一致掩码传播来识别。对于选定的关键帧，微调的扩散修复模型在遮挡区域生成合理的背景外观，而Metric3D v2从补全图像预测度量深度以初始化临时高斯基元。来源标签区分生成基元和观测支持的基元，将生成内容排除在相机位姿估计和观测地图优化之外。当先前被遮挡的背景变为可见时，符合条件生成基元被移除，观测支持的基元从真实RGB观测和预测深度独立初始化。实验结果表明具有竞争力的相机跟踪，在TUM RGB-D上的平均ATE RMSE为1.2 cm，在BONN RGB-D上为2.7 cm。在StaDy4D上，DPGS-SLAM仅使用单目RGB输入，将平均PSNR较WildGS-SLAM提高4.60 dB。

items.title_en: Accelerated Reinforcement Learning for Soft Robotics: Hours Instead of Years
items.title_zh: 软体机器人加速强化学习：数小时而非数年
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) requires large amounts of interaction data or a reliable simulator, both hard to obtain for nonlinear soft robotic hardware. Recent work shows that a time-scale separation inherent to soft robot dynamics justifies their reduction to low-dimensional invariant manifolds, known as adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs). We demonstrate that an aSSM-reduced model, a simple polynomial ordinary differential equation learned purely from pre-collected data, can serve as an RL training environment. On a pneumatically actuated soft arm, we train a trajectory-tracking policy in 3 hours on a six-dimensional aSSM-reduced model and deploy it without fine-tuning, whereas reproducing this policy training extrapolates to 3 years of hardware interaction. Our policy tracks dynamic targets with 40% lower error than otherwise identical policies trained on a 4.8-million-parameter recurrent neural network (RNN) or a 1.7-million-parameter transformer, which take 13 and 100 hours to identify, against 5 minutes for our mathematically justified 6,924-parameter model.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）需要大量交互数据或可靠的仿真器，而这两者对于非线性软体机器人硬件都难以获得。近期工作表明，软体机器人动力学固有的时间尺度分离为其约简到低维不变流形提供了依据，这些流形称为绝热谱子流形（aSSM）。我们证明，aSSM约简模型——一种仅从预先收集的数据学习得到的简单多项式常微分方程——可以作为RL训练环境。在气动驱动的软体臂上，我们在六维aSSM约简模型上于3小时内训练了一个轨迹跟踪策略，并在不进行微调的情况下部署它，而在硬件上复现该策略训练则外推为3年的硬件交互。与在4.8百万参数循环神经网络（RNN）或1.7百万参数Transformer上训练的其余相同策略相比，我们的策略跟踪动态目标的误差低40%；识别这些网络分别需要13小时和100小时，而我们数学上有依据的6,924参数模型仅需5分钟。
items.comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 3 extended data figures

items.title_en: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
items.title_zh: 面向低功耗机器人自主性的能量感知开放词汇检测调度
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够搜索运行时目标查询，但固定频率推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视角期间将嵌入式计算花费在低价值帧上。本文提出一种用于低功耗移动机器人的能量感知OVD调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度，在Jetson Orin Nano上的低、中、高功耗YOLO-World-S模式之间切换。我们在AgileX LIMO上使用40次真实导航试验评估能量-质量权衡：两个目标物体，每个目标-策略对五种放置，以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器记录8/10任务成功，而每个固定频率基线为7/10，同时相对于8 Hz高频基线将Jetson平均输入功率（Jetson侧功耗指标）降低5.2%，并将实际OVD调用率降低34.0%。它并未最小化任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量，因为更长的任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。单独的60 s静止微基准隔离感知工作负载：相对于8 Hz基线，调度器将平均功率从8.045 W降至7.301 W，能量从484.7 J降至438.1 J。这些结果支持机器人状态感知的OVD调度作为一种有前景的电源管理机制，并具有有竞争力的任务可靠性，同时表明任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量必须与任务进度和运行时间一起解读。
items.comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, accepted for publication in ICARCV 2026

items.title_en: Tension Tells the Tail: Cable-Obstacle Interaction Sensing for Tethered Mobile Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 张力揭示尾端：面向系留移动机器人导航的缆绳—障碍物交互感知
items.abstract_en: Tethered mobile robots can sustain long-duration operation through continuous power supply and stable communication via their cables. However, cable-environment interaction causes unintended obstacle displacement, cable snagging or entanglement, and even cable damage, leading to mission failure. To assess the risk of individual cable-obstacle contacts, this study investigates cable tension as a sensing modality for estimating whether a contacted obstacle is movable or non-movable. We conducted experiments with a tethered mobile robot and collected tension data while varying robot velocity, contact angle between the obstacle and cable, obstacle mass, and obstacle side-surface material. The results show that obstacle movability is characterized by the initial tension rise and, more importantly, by whether the tension relaxes or remains high after its peak. Based on these observations, we select six features from the tension profiles and train a logistic-regression classifier using 117 labeled trials. The proposed method distinguishes movable and non-movable cases with a balanced accuracy of 95.5% after 30 cm of post-contact travel. These results demonstrate the potential of cable tension for risk assessment of cable-obstacle interactions and provide a step toward online, cable-aware autonomous navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 系留移动机器人可通过缆绳持续供电和稳定通信来维持长时间运行。然而，缆绳与环境的交互会导致障碍物发生非预期位移、缆绳被勾挂或缠绕，甚至缆绳损坏，从而导致任务失败。为评估单次缆绳—障碍物接触的风险，本研究将缆绳张力作为一种传感模态，用于估计被接触障碍物是可移动的还是不可移动的。我们使用系留移动机器人开展实验，并在改变机器人速度、障碍物与缆绳之间的接触角、障碍物质量以及障碍物侧面材料的情况下采集张力数据。结果表明，障碍物可移动性可由初始张力上升来表征，更重要的是，可由张力在峰值之后是松弛还是保持高位来表征。基于这些观察，我们从张力曲线中选择六个特征，并使用117次带标签试验训练逻辑回归分类器。所提方法在接触后行进30 cm后以95.5%的平衡准确率区分可移动与不可移动情形。这些结果展示了缆绳张力用于缆绳—障碍物交互风险评估的潜力，并朝着在线、缆绳感知的自主导航迈进一步。
items.comment: 8 pages, 11 figures. Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics (SSRR)

items.title_en: RTISSLAM-3D: Full 6-DoF SLAM With an In-Air 3D Imaging Sonar
items.title_zh: RTISSLAM-3D：使用空中三维成像声呐的全6自由度SLAM
items.abstract_en: Echolocating bats navigate dense forests using sonar alone, and in-air 3D imaging sonars now capture the entire frontal hemisphere with every pulse. Sonar SLAM, however, has so far been planar: current systems estimate a 2D trajectory and discard the elevation information in the sonar images, an assumption that does not hold on rough and sloped terrain such as a forest floor. In this paper, we introduce RTISSLAM-3D, a novel 6-DoF SLAM system for a wheeled robot that carries an in-air 3D imaging sonar, an IMU and wheel encoders. A CFAR detector on the sphere reduces every sonar image to a sparse set of 3D detections, which we use for a 3D acoustic odometry that models the shape of the sonar beam, for place recognition with polar submap descriptors, and for the verification of loop closures by 3D registration, all combined in a 6-DoF pose graph with attitude factors. We evaluated RTISSLAM-3D on a 545m drive through a forest, with a 3D lidar SLAM as reference. The loop closures reduced the horizontal error of the acoustic odometry from 1.74m to 0.28m, with a height error of 0.12m, and 94.6% of the resulting 3D sonar map lies within 0.3 m of the lidar map.
items.abstract_zh: 回声定位蝙蝠仅依靠声呐就能在茂密森林中导航，而如今的空中三维成像声呐可在每次脉冲中捕获整个前半球。然而，声呐SLAM迄今仍是平面化的：当前系统估计二维轨迹并丢弃声呐图像中的高度信息，这一假设在崎岖和倾斜地形（如森林地面）上并不成立。本文介绍RTISSLAM-3D，这是一种新型6自由度SLAM系统，面向搭载空中三维成像声呐、IMU和轮式编码器的轮式机器人。球面上的CFAR检测器将每帧声呐图像简化为稀疏的三维检测集合，我们将其用于：建模声呐波束形状的三维声学里程计、使用极坐标子图描述子的位置识别，以及通过三维配准验证闭环；所有这些都结合在带有姿态因子的6自由度位姿图中。我们在穿越森林的545 m行驶中评估RTISSLAM-3D，并以三维激光雷达SLAM作为参考。闭环将声学里程计的水平误差从1.74 m降低到0.28 m，高度误差为0.12 m，所得三维声呐地图中有94.6%位于激光雷达地图的0.3 m范围内。

items.title_en: Real-world Latency Analysis of Vehicular Visible Light Communication with Multiple LED Transmitters and an Event-Based Camera
items.title_zh: 多LED发射机与事件相机车联网可见光通信的真实场景时延分析
items.abstract_en: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution, low latency, and wide dynamic range, making them promising receivers for visible light communication (VLC) in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) applications. This work presents an event-camera-based VLC system addressing three key challenges: bandwidth saturation, multi-transmitter reception, and latency characterization. We adopt a positive-event-only mode and design a protocol that suppresses event generation while maintaining communication distance and a wide field of view. We also propose a method to identify multiple transmitters and demonstrate simultaneous reception from up to three LEDs. Finally, we evaluate end-to-end latency in real vehicular scenarios and show that the system meets cooperative perception requirements. These results demonstrate that event-camera-based VLC is a feasible complement to existing V2X technologies (e.g., RF).
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率、低时延和宽动态范围，是车联网（V2X）中可见光通信（VLC）颇具前景的接收器。本文提出一种基于事件相机的VLC系统，应对带宽饱和、多发射机接收与时延刻画三大挑战。作者采用仅正事件模式，并设计协议以抑制事件产生，同时保持通信距离与宽视场；提出多发射机识别方法，演示了最多三盏LED的同时接收；最后在真实车辆场景中评估端到端时延，表明系统满足协同感知的需求。结果说明基于事件相机的VLC可作为现有V2X技术（如射频）的可行补充。
items.highlight_zh: 事件相机车联网VLC实测端到端时延，可支持三灯同时接收
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：车与车、车与路之间的通信（V2X）目前主要靠射频，但射频在拥堵信道和高密度场景下会受限。可见光通信可作为补充——车灯本来就在发光。问题是：普通相机帧率太低、延迟太大；而事件相机虽然响应极快（微秒级）、动态范围宽，用在车上却有三个实际障碍：事件输出速率太高会把带宽“撑爆”；一辆车视野里往往有多盏灯同时发送，怎么区分；以及在真实道路条件下端到端到底有多快，此前不清楚。

二、用了什么方法：作者采用“只取正事件”的工作模式（只响应变亮），并设计了一套协议主动抑制事件产生量，从而在保住通信距离和大视场的前提下避免数据洪流。针对多发射机，提出用空间位置区分不同LED的方法，实现最多三盏LED同时接收。最后搭建真实车载场景，测量从发到收的端到端时延。

三、有什么结果：系统能够同时接收三盏LED的信号，且端到端时延满足协同感知（车辆间共享感知数据）的实时性要求，证明该方案在真实车辆场景中可用。

四、为何重要：它把事件相机VLC从实验室演示推进到真实车辆场景，系统性地回答了“带宽够不够、多灯能不能分、快不快”这三个决定能否落地的关键问题，说明光通信可以成为射频V2X的实用补充。

items.title_en: An Open-Source Research Platform for Embedded Visible Light Networking
items.abstract_en: Despite the growing interest in Visible Light Communication (VLC), a reference networking platform based on commercial off-the-shelf components is not available yet. An open-source platform would lower the barriers to entry to VLC network research and help the VLC community gain momentum. We introduce OpenVLC, an open-source VLC research platform based on software-defined implementation. Built around a credit-card-sized embedded Linux platform with a simple opto-electronic transceiver front-end, OpenVLC offers a basic physical layer, a set of essential medium access primitives, as well as interoperability with Internet protocols. We investigate the performance of OpenVLC and show examples of how it can be used along with standard network diagnostics tools. Our software-defined implementation can currently reach throughput in the order of the basic rate of IEEE 802.15.7 standard. We discuss several techniques that researchers and engineers could introduce to improve the performance of OpenVLC and envision several directions that can benefit from OpenVLC by adopting it as a reference platform.
items.title_zh: 一个面向嵌入式可见光网络的的开源研究平台
items.abstract_zh: 尽管可见光通信（VLC）受到越来越多的关注，但基于商用现成组件的参考网络平台仍未出现。一个开源平台将降低VLC网络研究的入门门槛，并有助于VLC社区形成声势。我们推出OpenVLC——一个基于软件定义实现的开源VLC研究平台。OpenVLC围绕信用卡大小的嵌入式Linux平台构建，配有简单的光电收发前端，提供基础物理层、一组必要的介质访问原语，以及与互联网协议的互操作性。我们考察了OpenVLC的性能，并展示其如何与标准网络诊断工具配合使用的示例。我们的软件定义实现目前可达到与IEEE 802.15.7标准基本速率相当量级的吞吐量。我们讨论了研究人员与工程师可用于提升OpenVLC性能的若干技术，并展望了采用它作为参考平台而受益的多个方向。
items.highlight_zh: 推出开源软件定义可见光通信研究平台OpenVLC
items.digest_zh:
本研究要解决的问题是：可见光通信（VLC）研究热度上升，但社区缺少一个基于商用现成器件、可复现的参考网络平台，导致入门门槛高、各家实验难以对比。

作者的做法是构建 OpenVLC：硬件上采用信用卡大小的嵌入式 Linux 单板计算机，外接一个简单的光电收发前端；软件上采用软件定义的方式，自行实现基础物理层、若干必要的介质访问控制原语，并让系统能够与标准互联网协议互通，从而把 VLC 链路接入常规网络栈。

在结果方面，作者测量了 OpenVLC 的实际性能，并用标准网络诊断工具做了演示性实验，说明该平台可直接沿用现有网络调试方法；当前吞吐量达到 IEEE 802.15.7 标准基本速率的量级，属于可用但仍有提升空间的原型水平。文中还讨论了研究者可采用的若干性能改进手段。

其重要性在于：开源与低成本降低了 VLC 组网研究的门槛，使更多团队能复现与比较实验结果，有助于该领域形成共同基准；同时软件定义的架构便于快速试验新协议与新算法。它为可见光通信从点对点链路走向真正的网络化研究提供了可共享的起点。

items.title_en: Data-Driven Precision Control of Soft Helicoid Robots
items.title_zh: 软螺旋机器人数据驱动的精确控制
items.abstract_en: A purely data-driven method grounded in the theory of adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) was recently used to model and control nonlinear soft robotic simulators. Here, we extend the methodology to learn aSSM-reduced models from data collected from hardware soft robotic platforms. Specifically, we learn a five dimensional (5D) aSSM-reduced nonlinear ordinary differential equation (ODE) that accurately models the dynamics of a soft-helicoid trunk robot. We then use this ODE in a model predictive control scheme to demonstrate real-time precision control across various challenging closed-loop trajectory-tracking tasks, ranging from 2D to 3D trajectories with static and dynamic constraints. We find that our methodology enhances accuracy and precision across all control tasks compared to available data-driven linear methods and model-free reinforcement learning. While we focus here on a soft-helicoid trunk robot, our methodology relies solely on hardware data and is therefore applicable to a broader class of soft robotic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 最近，一种基于绝热谱子流形（aSSM）理论的纯数据驱动方法被用于对非线性软体机器人仿真器进行建模和控制。在此，我们将该方法扩展为从硬件软体机器人平台采集的数据中学习aSSM降阶模型。具体而言，我们学习了一个五维（5D）aSSM降阶非线性常微分方程（ODE），能够准确建模软螺旋躯干机器人的动力学。随后，我们在模型预测控制方案中使用该ODE，在从2D到3D轨迹、包含静态和动态约束的各种挑战性闭环轨迹跟踪任务中展示实时精确控制。我们发现，与现有的数据驱动线性方法和无模型强化学习相比，我们的方法在所有控制任务中提高了准确性和精度。虽然我们在此关注的是软螺旋躯干机器人，但我们的方法仅依赖硬件数据，因此适用于更广泛的软体机器人系统。

items.title_en: TPS-A*: Path Planning for Any-Shape Vehicles with Certified Collision Checking in Trajectory Parameter Space
items.title_zh: TPS-A*：在轨迹参数空间中执行经认证碰撞检测的任意形状车辆路径规划
items.abstract_en: Global planners for ground vehicles usually approximate the vehicle by a disk, trading safety against conservativeness, while exact-footprint checking pays for every candidate motion, pose, and footprint edge. We present TPS-A*, a lattice planner whose edges are kinematically feasible trajectories from parameterized trajectory generators, built on certified collision checking in trajectory parameter space. A grid precomputed per footprint returns, in one pass over the local obstacles, a certified free distance along every candidate trajectory, so the per-node collision cost is independent of footprint complexity and trajectory count. We prove that this grid never overestimates the free distance of the continuously swept, possibly non-convex footprint, and state the planner's guarantees: collision-free paths and bounded suboptimality relative to its lattice abstraction. Goals with or without heading are reached exactly by Reeds-Shepp shots certified as trajectories of the same generators. An exact independent test finds no collision in its paths. On 300 cluttered worlds, with the true footprint and the same goal pose for all planners, it solves every query with a collision-free goal pose in a median of three milliseconds on an AMD Ryzen 7 2700X, on par with hybrid A*, 45\% of whose paths overlap obstacles, and nearly sixty times faster than a state-lattice planner, the only other collision-free one; with position goals, eighty-nine times faster than hybrid A*. It matches hybrid A* in automated parking and on narrow doorways, docks a non-convex fork footprint that no convex model admits, and drove a real robot across a university campus among people.
items.abstract_zh: 地面车辆的全局规划器通常用圆盘近似车辆，在安全性与保守性之间权衡，而精确足迹检查需要为每个候选运动、位姿和足迹边缘付出计算代价。我们提出 TPS-A*，一种格点规划器，其边是来自参数化轨迹生成器的运动学可行轨迹，建立在轨迹参数空间中的经认证碰撞检测之上。按足迹预计算的一张网格在对局部障碍物的一趟遍历中，返回沿每条候选轨迹的经认证自由距离，因此每个节点的碰撞代价与足迹复杂度和轨迹数量无关。我们证明该网格从不高估连续扫掠的、可能非凸足迹的自由距离，并给出规划器的保证：无碰撞路径，以及相对于其格点抽象的有界次优性。有朝向或无朝向的目标均由 Reeds-Shepp shots 精确到达，这些 shots 被认证为同一组生成器的轨迹。一个精确的独立测试在其路径中未发现碰撞。在 300 个杂乱世界中，使用真实足迹且所有规划器采用相同目标位姿，它在 AMD Ryzen 7 2700X 上以中位数三毫秒求解每个具有无碰撞目标位姿的查询，与 hybrid A* 相当，而 hybrid A* 有 45% 的路径与障碍物重叠；它比状态格点规划器快近六十倍，后者是唯一另一个无碰撞的规划器；对于位置目标，它比 hybrid A* 快八十九倍。它在自动泊车和狭窄门口场景中与 hybrid A* 相当，能对接一个没有凸模型可接纳的非凸叉形足迹，并驱动一台真实机器人在有人群的大学校园中穿行。
items.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures

items.title_en: Visual-Inertial RGB-D SLAM with Encoders for a Differential Wheeled Robot
items.title_zh: 面向差速轮式机器人、带编码器的视觉-惯性RGB-D SLAM
items.abstract_en: Recent years have seen multiple impressive results in visual-inertial odometry (VIO) techniques, by which accurate state estimation can be achieved via the extended Kalman filter (EKF) or nonlinear optimization. However, these approaches are rarely open source, and they tend to fail in real experiments due to the temporary lack of feature points and fast motion. Therefore, in this study, we used encoders to overcome the temporary failure of purely vision-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Here, we propose a generative measurement model for encoders and derive an expression for the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and necessary Jacobians for optimization. We use our theory to present a novel tightly coupled visual-inertial encoder RGB-Depth (RGB-D) SLAM system. Tests on our system on an in-house dataset confirmed that our modeling effort led to accurate (with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of approximately 2-7 cm) and robust state estimation in real time. The source code and our dataset containing the encoder information have been published for verification.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）技术取得了多项令人印象深刻的结果，可通过扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）或非线性优化实现准确的状态估计。然而，这些方法很少开源，并且由于特征点暂时缺失和快速运动，往往在实际实验中失败。因此，在本研究中，我们使用编码器来克服纯视觉同时定位与建图（SLAM）的暂时失效。在此，我们提出一种编码器的生成式测量模型，并推导最大后验（MAP）估计的表达式以及优化所需的雅可比矩阵。我们利用该理论提出一种新型紧耦合视觉-惯性-编码器RGB-深度（RGB-D）SLAM系统。在自建数据集上对我们系统的测试证实，我们的建模工作实现了准确（均方根误差（RMSE）约为2–7 cm）且鲁棒的实时状态估计。源代码以及包含编码器信息的数据集已发布以供验证。

items.title_en: Capability-Conditioned Graph Control Barrier Functions for Zero-Shot Safe Navigation of Heterogeneous Mobile Robot Teams
items.title_zh: 面向异构移动机器人团队零样本安全导航的能力条件图控制屏障函数
items.abstract_en: Multi-robot systems are increasingly deployed as heterogeneous fleets with diverse kinematic and actuation capabilities. While graph control barrier function (GCBF) methods provide a scalable framework for decentralized safe control, existing approaches typically assume homogeneous robot dynamics. Methods that directly encode robot classes can distinguish known types, but do not represent state-dependent motion capabilities or naturally transfer to unseen robot models. To address this challenge, we propose the Capability-Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph Control Barrier Function (CC-HGCBF), defined in a shared second-order reference-point operational space. This formulation provides a common geometric representation of safety across heterogeneous robots while retaining their model-specific dynamics and admissible control constraints. To enable zero-shot transfer, we introduce the Radial Capability Field (RCF), a compact, fixed-dimensional representation of each robot's state-dependent finite-horizon reachable velocity set. Conditioning the shared graph barrier and decentralized policy on the RCF enables them to adapt to changes in robot state, kinematic constraints, and control limits without relying on predefined robot identities. We jointly train the barrier and policy using proactive safety labeling and neural CBF-QP supervision, and evaluate them on mixed teams containing both seen and unseen robot models. Experiments demonstrate scalable safe coordination and zero-shot transfer to robot models and capability variations withheld during training. Physical-robot experiments further demonstrate zero-shot deployment to unseen kinematic models without retraining.
items.abstract_zh: 多机器人系统越来越多地以具有多样运动学和驱动能力的异构车队形式部署。尽管图控制屏障函数（GCBF）方法为分散式安全控制提供了可扩展框架，现有方法通常假设同质机器人动力学。直接编码机器人类别的方法可以区分已知类型，但不能表示状态相关的运动能力，也不能自然迁移到未见过的机器人模型。为应对这一挑战，我们提出能力条件异构图控制屏障函数（CC-HGCBF），定义在共享的二阶参考点操作空间中。该公式为异构机器人提供共同的安全几何表示，同时保留其模型特定的动力学和容许控制约束。为实现零样本迁移，我们引入径向能力场（RCF），这是每个机器人状态相关的有限时域可达速度集的紧凑固定维表示。将共享图屏障和分散式策略以RCF为条件，使其能够适应机器人状态、运动学约束和控制限的变化，而不依赖预定义的机器人身份。我们使用主动安全标注和神经CBF-QP监督联合训练屏障和策略，并在包含已见和未见机器人模型的混合团队上评估。实验证明了可扩展的安全协调，以及对训练期间未保留的机器人模型和能力变化的零样本迁移。物理机器人实验进一步证明无需重新训练即可零样本部署到未见过的运动学模型。
items.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables

items.title_en: Learning Direct Control from Optimization for Dynamic Target Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向动态目标跟踪的从优化学习直接控制
items.abstract_en: Dynamic target tracking requires a mobile robot to maintain target visibility while navigating obstacles with smooth, feasible controls. Online trajectory optimization explicitly encodes these objectives but requires repeated numerical solving, whereas waypoint-based neural policies separate geometric prediction from control execution. We introduce LECO, a framework that transfers tracking optimization into offline learning of a direct-control policy. LECO predicts control sequences and maps them to trajectories through a differentiable kinematic model, allowing trajectory-level objectives to directly guide control learning. A decaying expert-guidance curriculum initializes effective tracking behavior and progressively shifts learning toward these task objectives. At deployment, a predictive safety lock checks short-horizon obstacle clearance and invokes a classical planning and control fallback when the predicted motion is unsafe or the target prediction is invalid. Across three simulated obstacle densities, LECO reduces root-mean-square linear jerk by 14.1--31.2\% relative to the best competing method for this metric and achieves the highest tracking success rate, with per-cycle computation times of 4.25--5.63\,ms. Experiments on two robot platforms further demonstrate tracking through indoor narrow passages and outdoor forest environments. These results demonstrate that learning direct control from optimization enables smooth and robust dynamic target tracking.
items.abstract_zh: 动态目标跟踪要求移动机器人在避障的同时保持目标可见，并以平滑、可行的控制进行导航。在线轨迹优化显式编码这些目标，但需要反复数值求解；而基于路点的神经策略将几何预测与控制执行分离。我们提出LECO，一个将跟踪优化迁移为直接控制策略离线学习的框架。LECO预测控制序列，并通过可微分运动学模型将其映射为轨迹，使轨迹级目标能够直接指导控制学习。一种衰减的专家引导课程初始化有效跟踪行为，并逐步将学习转向这些任务目标。部署时，预测安全锁检查短时域障碍物净空，并在预测运动不安全或目标预测无效时调用经典规划与控制回退。在三种仿真障碍物密度下，LECO相对于该指标上最佳竞争方法将均方根线性加加速度降低14.1--31.2%，并取得最高跟踪成功率，每周期计算时间为4.25--5.63 ms。在两个机器人平台上的实验进一步展示了室内狭窄通道和室外森林环境中的跟踪。这些结果表明，从优化中学习直接控制能够实现平滑且稳健的动态目标跟踪。

items.title_en: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models
items.title_zh: ARC-SORT：基于交互式多模型的自适应、鲁棒、补偿式多目标跟踪
items.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 体育转播中的多目标跟踪之所以困难，有两个原因：运动员移动速度快且会突然改变方向，同时摄像机还会平移和变焦。我们提出 ARC-SORT（自适应、鲁棒、补偿式 SORT），一种基于检测的跟踪器，无需训练且可实时运行。其设计规则是：跟踪器度量自身的不确定性，并由该度量决定其行为方式。交互式多模型（IMM）卡尔曼滤波器为每个轨迹给出预测协方差，我们将其转化为每条轨迹的搜索区域：运动预测越不可靠，检测可能匹配的区域就越大（不确定性自适应 Expansion IoU，EIoU）。在相同输入上，这种连续耦合才是关键：将同一协方差用作硬马氏门控，在我们扫描的每个阈值下都会造成损害，而更丰富的协方差摘要没有带来可测量的增益。当两条轨迹交叉时，分配代价本身会报告该决策是否接近边界。ARC-SORT 将此类轨迹对置于复核状态，并在交叉后的外观证据表明首次决策错误时，至多应用一次纠正性身份交换；这在 SportsMOT 和 DanceTrack 测试集上均带来 +1.0 HOTA（高阶跟踪准确率），且每帧耗时低于 1 毫秒。对于离开画面数秒的球员，运动外推不携带信息，因此我们的离线重识别去掉通常的运动门控，仅通过外观关联轨迹片段。ARC-SORT 在 SportsMOT 测试集上达到 81.82 HOTA，在截至 2026 年 8 月的 69 个排行榜条目中身份切换最少，并以 97.09 的多目标跟踪准确率（MOTA）并列第三；在相同的关联设置下，在 DanceTrack 测试集上达到 62.1 HOTA。在 Deep-EIoU 的公开检测和嵌入上，它达到 80.31 HOTA，比 Deep-EIoU 高 +3.1。在笔记本电脑 RTX 3060 GPU 上以约 50 帧/秒运行。代码将发布。

items.title_en: Detector-Integrated Multi-Cue Association for Occlusion-Aware UAV Multi-Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向遮挡感知无人机多目标跟踪的检测器集成多线索关联
items.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenging because vehicles are small, visually similar, and frequently occluded, which leads to identity switches (IDSW). Appearance-based trackers such as DeepSORT rely on a standalone re-identification (ReID) network, whose per-target inference limits runtime speed, while the appearance of small or occluded vehicles remains unreliable. This paper proposes a detector-integrated multi-cue tracking framework. Lightweight projection heads are attached to the neck of the YOLOv8n detector to extract target embeddings through ROIAlign, producing detections and embeddings in a single forward pass. A multi-cue association cost then combines motion, IoU, and appearance distances with weights determined through ablation, complemented by low-score rescue and appearance-memory protection. On the UAVDT benchmark, the proposed method achieves a MOTA of 28.33, a HOTA of 31.16, and an IDF1 of 38.18 at 82.59 FPS, the best among the compared trackers in all three metrics, and reduces IDSW by 58.4\% compared with DeepSORT.
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）图像中的多目标跟踪（MOT）具有挑战性，因为车辆目标小、视觉上相似且经常被遮挡，从而导致身份切换（IDSW）。诸如DeepSORT等基于外观的跟踪器依赖独立的重新识别（ReID）网络，其逐目标推理限制了运行速度，而小型或被遮挡车辆的外观仍不可靠。本文提出一种检测器集成的多线索跟踪框架。在YOLOv8n检测器的颈部附加轻量投影头，通过ROIAlign提取目标嵌入，在单次前向传播中生成检测结果和嵌入。然后，多线索关联代价将运动、IoU和外观距离相结合，其权重通过消融确定，并辅以低分救援和外观记忆保护。在UAVDT基准上，所提方法在82.59 FPS下达到MOTA 28.33、HOTA 31.16和IDF1 38.18，在三个指标上均为比较跟踪器中的最佳，并且与DeepSORT相比将IDSW降低58.4%。

items.title_en: JARVIS: From Visual Manuals to Autonomous Robotic Assembly
items.title_zh: JARVIS：从视觉手册到自主机器人装配
items.abstract_en: Visual manuals communicate procedural knowledge through stepwise diagrams, but translating these instructions into reliable long-horizon robotic execution remains challenging. We introduce JARVIS, a method-agnostic benchmark for autonomous visual-manual-guided execution without additional language instructions. JARVIS comprises 236,679 LEGO assembly tasks across 8,987 scenes, with a carefully curated JARVIS-v1 suite of 50 tasks for interactive robotic evaluation. Tasks span varying initial structural complexities and assembly horizons, requiring agents to interpret manuals, ground actions in an evolving workspace, and execute the intended procedure. A structure-aware evaluation protocol captures geometric accuracy, structural relations, construction order, partial progress, and completion. We further introduce JARVIS-agentic, a tool-grounded embodied agent that composes robot primitives into executable programs and uses execution feedback for verification and recovery, without task-specific action trajectories or model parameter updates. Across nine multimodal and reasoning models, task-oriented primitives increase the average assembly score. Performance nevertheless declines sharply with assembly horizon, and execution errors remain difficult to correct. Prior-task experience improves initial performance, while repeated reflection provides inconsistent benefits, highlighting persistent limitations in connecting visual procedural reasoning with reliable physical execution.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉手册通过分步图示传达程序性知识，但将这些指令转化为可靠的长时程机器人执行仍然具有挑战性。我们提出JARVIS，一个与具体方法无关的基准，用于在无额外语言指令条件下进行自主的视觉手册引导执行。JARVIS包含8,987个场景中的236,679个LEGO装配任务，并配有精心策划的JARVIS-v1套件，包含50个用于交互式机器人评估的任务。任务涵盖不同的初始结构复杂度和装配时程，要求智能体解释手册、在不断变化的工作空间中将动作落地，并执行预期流程。结构感知评估协议捕捉几何精度、结构关系、装配顺序、部分进展和完成情况。我们进一步提出JARVIS-agentic，一种基于工具的具身智能体，它将机器人原语组合成可执行程序，并利用执行反馈进行验证和恢复，无需任务特定动作轨迹或模型参数更新。在九个多模态和推理模型上，面向任务的原语提高了平均装配得分。然而性能仍随装配时程增加而急剧下降，执行错误仍难以纠正。先前任务经验可提升初始性能，而重复反思带来的收益不一致，凸显了将视觉程序性推理与可靠物理执行相连接方面的持续局限。

items.title_en: DROID-SLAM in the Wild
items.title_zh: DROID-SLAM：在野外环境中
items.abstract_en: We present a robust, real-time RGB SLAM system that handles dynamic environments by leveraging differentiable Uncertainty-aware Bundle Adjustment. Traditional SLAM methods typically assume static scenes, leading to tracking failures in the presence of motion. Recent dynamic SLAM approaches attempt to address this challenge using predefined dynamic priors or uncertainty-aware mapping, but they remain limited when confronted with unknown dynamic objects or highly cluttered scenes where geometric mapping becomes unreliable. In contrast, our method estimates per-pixel uncertainty by exploiting multi-view visual feature inconsistency, enabling robust tracking and reconstruction even in real-world environments. The proposed system achieves state-of-the-art camera poses and scene geometry in cluttered dynamic scenarios while running in real time at around 10 FPS. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个鲁棒的实时RGB SLAM系统，通过利用可微的不确定性感知光束法平差来处理动态环境。传统SLAM方法通常假设静态场景，在存在运动时会导致跟踪失败。近期动态SLAM方法尝试使用预定义动态先验或不确定性感知建图来应对这一挑战，但在面对未知动态物体或高度杂乱、几何建图变得不可靠的场景时仍受限。相比之下，我们的方法利用多视图视觉特征不一致性估计逐像素不确定性，即使在真实世界环境中也能实现鲁棒跟踪与重建。所提出系统在杂乱的动态场景中实现最先进的相机位姿和场景几何，同时以约10 FPS实时运行。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git。

items.title_en: Noise Mitigation Methods for Digital Visible Light Communication
items.title_zh: 数字可见光通信的噪声抑制方法
items.abstract_en: Visible Light Communication (VLC) using Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) has gained attention due to its low power consumption, long lifetime, and fast response. However, VLC suffers from optical noise generated by ambient light sources such as fluorescent lamps, which leads to waveform distortion and increased bit error rates (BER). In this paper, we propose two noise reduction methods for Digital Visible Light Communication (DVLC) systems. The first method exploits the periodic nature of interference caused by AC-powered-line illumination and reduces interference by subtracting sampled noise waveforms from the received signal. Second, inspired by Active Noise Control (ANC) techniques, an additional photodiode is introduced for noise reception, and subtraction circuits are employed to attenuate noise in real time. Experimental results show that both methods improve BER performance compared with conventional receivers, with the ANC-inspired approach achieving superior performance under all tested conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 使用发光二极管（LED）的可见光通信（VLC）因其低功耗、长寿命和快速响应而受到关注。然而，VLC受到荧光灯等环境光源产生的光学噪声影响，导致波形失真和误码率（BER）升高。本文针对数字可见光通信（DVLC）系统提出两种降噪方法。第一种方法利用交流供电线路照明所造成干扰的周期性，通过从接收信号中减去采样噪声波形来降低干扰。第二种方法受主动噪声控制（ANC）技术启发，引入额外光电二极管接收噪声，并采用减法电路实时衰减噪声。实验结果表明，与常规接收机相比，两种方法均改善了BER性能，其中受ANC启发的方法在所有测试条件下取得更优性能。

items.title_en: Symbol Rate Maximization in Rolling-Shutter OCC: Design and Implementation Considerations
items.abstract_en: Optical Camera Communication (OCC) systems can take advantage of the row-by-row scanning process of rolling-shutter cameras to capture the fast variations of light intensity coming from Visible Light Communication (VLC) LED-based transmitters. In order to study the maximum data rate that is feasible in such kind of OCC systems, this paper presents its equivalent digital communication system model in which the rolling-shutter camera is modeled as a rectangular matched-filter whose time width is equal to the exposure time of the camera, followed by a sampling process at the pixel row sweep rate of the camera. Based on the proposed rolling-shutter camera model, the maximum symbol rate that such OCC systems can support is experimentally demonstrated, and the impact of imperfect time synchronization between the VLC transmitter and the rolling-shutter OCC receiver is characterized in the form of Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI). The equivalent three-tap channel model that results from this process is experimentally validated and the generated ISI is compensated with the use of linear equalization in reception. Simulation and experimental results show a strong correlation between them, demonstrating that the proposed approach can be used to make the OCC system work at the Nyquist sampling rate, which is equivalent to the pixel row sweep rate of the rolling-shutter camera used in reception.
items.title_zh: 卷帘快门OCC中的符号速率最大化：设计与实现考量
items.abstract_zh: 光学相机通信（OCC）系统可利用卷帘快门相机的逐行扫描过程，捕获可见光通信（VLC）LED发射机光强的快速变化。为研究此类OCC系统可实现的最大数据速率，本文将卷帘快门相机等效为时间宽度等于曝光时间的矩形匹配滤波器，其后按相机像素行扫描速率进行采样，从而建立等效数字通信系统模型。基于该模型，实验验证了系统可支持的最大符号速率，并将VLC发射机与OCC接收机之间时间同步不完美的影响刻画为符号间干扰（ISI）。实验验证了由此得到的等效三抽头信道模型，并在接收端采用线性均衡补偿产生的ISI。仿真与实验结果高度吻合，表明该方法可使OCC系统工作在奈奎斯特采样速率，即接收所用卷帘快门相机的像素行扫描速率。
items.highlight_zh: 将卷帘快门相机建模为矩形匹配滤波器，实现奈奎斯特速率传输
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：可见光通信中，用普通卷帘快门相机当接收机（即OCC）时，相机的逐行扫描恰好能记录LED光强的快速明暗变化。但这类系统的速率上限到底是多少、受什么限制，此前缺乏系统分析。

二、用了什么方法：作者把相机等效成通信系统中的“矩形匹配滤波器”——其积分时间就是相机曝光时间，之后以像素行扫描速率进行采样，从而得到一个可与经典数字通信理论对接的等效模型。在此模型下，作者实验测出了可支持的最大符号速率，并把发射端与接收端时间不同步造成的后果，统一刻画为符号间干扰（ISI），进而推出一个等效三抽头信道模型，并在接收端用线性均衡加以补偿。

三、有什么结果：仿真与实测结果高度一致，验证了三抽头信道模型的正确性；线性均衡能有效消除失配带来的ISI，使系统在奈奎斯特速率下工作，也就是恰好等于相机像素行扫描速率——即每个像素行承载一个符号，不留冗余。

四、为何重要：这给出了OCC系统速率设计的“理论天花板”与工程做法。过去设计者常靠降低速率来躲避同步误差，本文说明只要建模正确、接收端做均衡，就能把相机扫描速率用满，为高速相机通信的实用化提供了可操作的准则。

items.title_en: Semantic Extraction Framework for Goal-Oriented V2X Communication Supporting Safe Intersection Passage
items.title_zh: 支持安全交叉口通行的面向目标V2X通信语义提取框架
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes a transmitter-side semantic extraction framework for goal-oriented Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication supporting safe intersection passage. Instead of transmitting raw sensory data, roadside infrastructure extracts task-relevant semantic information from video and traffic-signal sequences and organizes them into compact semantic packets for low-latency driving-decision assistance. The intersection-passing problem is formulated as a set of traffic tasks under Japanese traffic regulations, and the proposed pipeline generates perception and intent semantics through object detection, object tracking, region-of-interest (ROI)-based semantic extraction, and recommended-action generation. The framework is implemented and evaluated on a self-constructed, CARLA-based single-vehicle dataset collected under clear weather conditions. Experimental results show high recommended-action accuracy within the tested task set, while the mean processing latency remains below the frame interval of the 15~fps input video.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种发射端语义提取框架，用于支持安全交叉口通行的面向目标车联网（V2X）通信。路侧基础设施不传输原始感知数据，而是从视频和交通信号序列中提取任务相关语义信息，并将其组织为紧凑语义包，以低时延辅助驾驶决策。交叉口通行问题被形式化为日本交通法规下的一组交通任务，所提流程通过目标检测、目标跟踪、基于感兴趣区域（ROI）的语义提取和推荐动作生成来产生感知语义和意图语义。该框架在自行构建的、基于CARLA的单车数据集上实现并评估，该数据集在晴朗天气条件下采集。实验结果表明，在测试任务集内具有较高的推荐动作准确率，同时平均处理时延保持在15 fps输入视频的帧间隔以下。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cl
items.title_en: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
items.title_zh: Generalized-CVO：基于二阶黎曼优化的快速无对应局部点云配准
items.abstract_en: We propose a fast and correspondence-free local point cloud registration method that leverages geometric surface structure and reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) embeddings. The method represents point clouds as continuous functions with point-wise anisotropic kernels that encode local geometry. This formulation improves alignment along surface normals while relaxing alignment along tangential directions. To solve the resulting registration problem, we propose a second-order on-manifold optimization scheme with approximate Riemannian Hessians, achieving a speedup of up to 10x over the first-order solvers used in prior correspondence-free RKHS-based methods. We demonstrate improved frame-to-frame LiDAR and RGB-D tracking accuracy across diverse indoor and outdoor datasets. On a LiDAR tracking registration task in the driving domain, we achieve a reduction of >55% in both translational and rotational drift in challenging feature-sparse environments. On object registration benchmarks, we show improved robustness over ICP-based methods and further gains when refining global initialization, particularly under moderate misalignment.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种快速且无对应的局部点云配准方法，利用几何表面结构和再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）嵌入。该方法将点云表示为具有逐点各向异性核的连续函数，这些核编码局部几何。该形式改善了沿表面法向的对齐，同时放宽了沿切向方向的对齐。为求解所得配准问题，我们提出一种采用近似黎曼Hessian的二阶流形优化方案，相较于先前无对应RKHS方法中使用的一阶求解器，实现最高10倍的加速。我们在多样化的室内和室外数据集上展示了帧到帧LiDAR和RGB-D跟踪精度的提升。在驾驶领域的LiDAR跟踪配准任务中，我们在具有挑战性的特征稀疏环境中将平移和旋转漂移均降低超过55%。在物体配准基准上，我们展示了相较于基于ICP的方法更好的鲁棒性，并且在精化全局初始化时获得进一步增益，尤其是在中等程度失配下。

items.title_en: HomeLoop: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot-IoT Coordination in Everyday Domestic Assistance and Safety
items.title_zh: HomeLoop：用于日常家庭辅助与安全中机器人-IoT 协调的仿真框架与基准
items.abstract_en: Recent progress in embodied robotics is bringing robots closer to deployment in homes, as vision-language models (VLMs) are demonstrating significant advances in reasoning, making VLM-driven robots promising home assistant agents. These agents will often be introduced into homes that already have cameras, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and residents with wearables. To fulfill their potential, they need to integrate with existing smart infrastructure and reason through ambiguous scenarios: a smoke alarm may come from a pan about to ignite, a pan already on fire, a resident cooking or a faulty sensor, and each calls for a different response. To that end, we introduce HomeLoop, a simulation framework and benchmark built on Isaac Sim that combines robot bodies, networked devices and wearables, simulated residents and visitors, faulty sensors, and hazards that evolve over time. Our benchmark is composed of 20 tasks across five families grounded in real-world household hazards and needs, and designed so that the same alert can have different causes. A runtime monitor scores each episode with temporal-logic checks on the final outcome and the actions along the way, and every action carries a predefined cost. We evaluate six open-weight and proprietary VLMs. The best achieves a family-balanced score of 61.9%, and across models we see a pattern of over-reaction: failed episodes involving prohibited interventions outnumber those involving missed required interventions by more than two to one, with models often shutting off the stove before investigating the alarm's cause. HomeLoop is an extensible foundation intended for use in research on robot-IoT coordination, long-term memory, proactive assistance, and privacy-safety trade-offs. HomeLoop will be released with 2,100 home layouts that can be automatically furnished in diverse configurations, five robot bodies and 20 networked device types.
items.abstract_zh: 具身机器人学的最新进展正使机器人更接近在家庭中部署，因为视觉-语言模型（VLM）在推理方面展现出显著进步，使由 VLM 驱动的机器人成为有前景的家庭助手智能体。这些智能体常将被引入已经拥有摄像头、物联网（IoT）设备和佩戴可穿戴设备的居民的家庭中。为发挥其潜力，它们需要与现有智能基础设施集成，并对模糊场景进行推理：烟雾报警可能来自即将起火的锅、已经着火的锅、正在做饭的居民或故障传感器，而每种情况需要不同的响应。为此，我们提出 HomeLoop，一个基于 Isaac Sim 构建的仿真框架与基准，它结合了机器人本体、联网设备与可穿戴设备、模拟居民与访客、故障传感器以及随时间演化的危险。我们的基准由五个任务族中的 20 个任务组成，这些任务基于真实家庭危险与需求，并被设计为同一警报可以具有不同原因。运行时监视器通过对最终结果和沿途动作进行时序逻辑检查来为每个回合评分，并且每个动作都带有预定义代价。我们评估了六个开放权重和专有 VLM。最佳模型达到 61.9% 的族平衡分数；跨模型我们观察到一种过度反应模式：涉及禁止干预的失败回合数量，以超过二比一的比例多于涉及遗漏所需干预的失败回合，模型常常在调查警报原因之前关闭炉灶。HomeLoop 是一个可扩展的基础，旨在用于机器人-IoT 协调、长期记忆、主动辅助以及隐私-安全权衡的研究。HomeLoop 将随附 2,100 个可按多样配置自动布置家具的家居布局、五种机器人本体和 20 种联网设备类型一同发布。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object T
items.title_en: An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 一种用于视觉目标跟踪的高效Token压缩框架
items.abstract_en: Refining visual representations by eliminating their internal feature-level redundancy is crucial for simultaneously optimizing the performance and computational cost of models in visual tracking. To enhance their performance, many contemporary Transformer-based trackers leverage a larger number of historical template frames to capture richer spatio-temporal cues. However, this strategy leads to a massive number of input visual tokens. This creates two critical issues: it imposes a quadratic computational burden and can also degrade the tracker's overall performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a compress-then-interact tracking framework, ETCTrack, that learns to efficiently compress template tokens from historical template frames into a robust target representation, moving beyond handcrafted rules. Our method first employs the Adaptive Token Compressor to dynamically construct compact yet highly discriminative template tokens by filtering out redundant visual tokens. These refined template tokens are then processed by our Hierarchical Interaction Encoder to achieve a deep, adaptive interaction with the search features. Refined search features ensure subsequent precise target localization. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art trackers. ETCTrack-B224 reduces the number of template tokens by 60%, leading to a 21.4% reduction in MACs with only a 0.4% drop in accuracy. The source code are available at https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack.
items.abstract_zh: 通过消除视觉表示内部的特征级冗余来精炼视觉表示，对于同时优化视觉跟踪模型的性能和计算成本至关重要。为提升性能，许多当代基于Transformer的跟踪器利用更多历史模板帧来捕获更丰富的时空线索。然而，这一策略会导致输入视觉Token数量巨大。这带来两个关键问题：造成二次计算负担，并且还可能降低跟踪器的整体性能。为弥补这一差距，我们提出一种先压缩后交互的跟踪框架ETCTrack，它学习将历史模板帧中的模板Token高效压缩为鲁棒的目标表示，超越手工设计的规则。我们的方法首先采用自适应Token压缩器，通过滤除冗余视觉Token来动态构建紧凑且高度判别性的模板Token。随后，这些精炼后的模板Token由我们的分层交互编码器处理，以与搜索特征实现深度、自适应的交互。精炼后的搜索特征确保后续精确的目标定位。在七个基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的跟踪器。ETCTrack-B224将模板Token数量减少60%，使MACs降低21.4%，而精度仅下降0.4%。源代码见 https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack。

items.title_en: Lodos: A Lightweight Simulator Designed for Contact-Rich Interactions with Detailed Meshes
items.title_zh: Lodos：一个为与详细网格进行富接触交互而设计的轻量级仿真器
items.abstract_en: In recent years, massively parallelized rigid-body simulation has played a central role in robotics research, enabling rapid progress in areas such as reinforcement learning, stochastic optimal control, and randomized smoothing-based trajectory optimization. Particularly in contact-rich settings, the scalability of such simulations in large part depends on well-optimized representations of collision geometry, often requiring a coarse approximation of the underlying surfaces using primitives such as spheres, capsules, cylinders, and boxes. Whenever the complexity of the surfaces or the precision demands of the application render such approximations insufficient, it is instead necessary to employ mesh-mesh collisions, which impose a significant reduction in throughput. This paper proposes a simulation framework designed from scratch to address this bottleneck, with novel routines for broadphase and narrowphase collision detection as well as the subsequent contact dynamics computation. As experimentally validated, the framework matches existing well-established simulators in terms of physical faithfulness, and can achieve approximately an order of magnitude higher throughput in the detailed mesh-mesh collision setting that it specializes in. The source code is available at https://github.com/martius-lab/lodos.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，大规模并行化刚体仿真在机器人研究中发挥了核心作用，推动了强化学习、随机最优控制和基于随机平滑的轨迹优化等领域的快速进展。特别是在富接触场景中，此类仿真的可扩展性在很大程度上取决于经过良好优化的碰撞几何表示，通常需要使用球体、胶囊体、圆柱体和长方体等基元对底层表面进行粗略近似。当表面复杂度或应用的精度要求使此类近似不足时，就需要转而采用网格-网格碰撞，而这会显著降低吞吐量。本文提出一个从零开始设计的仿真框架以解决该瓶颈，其中包含用于宽相与窄相碰撞检测以及后续接触动力学计算的新颖例程。经实验验证，该框架在物理保真度方面与现有成熟仿真器相当，并在其专门处理的详细网格-网格碰撞设置中实现约一个数量级的更高吞吐量。源代码可在 https://github.com/martius-lab/lodos 获取。

items.title_en: Smart Visual Beacons with Asynchronous Optical Communications using Event Cameras
items.abstract_en: Event cameras are bio-inspired dynamic vision sensors that respond to changes in image intensity with a high temporal resolution, high dynamic range and low latency. These sensor characteristics are ideally suited to enable visual target tracking in concert with a broadcast visual communication channel for smart visual beacons with applications in distributed robotics. Visual beacons can be constructed by high-frequency modulation of Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) such as vehicle headlights, Internet of Things (IoT) LEDs, smart building lights, etc., that are already present in many real-world scenarios. The high temporal resolution characteristic of the event cameras allows them to capture visual signals at far higher data rates compared to classical frame-based cameras. In this paper, we propose a novel smart visual beacon architecture with both LED modulation and event camera demodulation algorithms. We quantitatively evaluate the relationship between LED transmission rate, communication distance and the message transmission accuracy for the smart visual beacon communication system that we prototyped. The proposed method achieves up to 4 kbps in an indoor environment and lossless transmission over a distance of 100 meters, at a transmission rate of 500 bps, in full sunlight, demonstrating the potential of the technology in an outdoor environment.
items.title_zh: 使用事件相机的异步光通信智能视觉信标
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机是受生物启发的动态视觉传感器，以高时间分辨率、高动态范围和低延迟响应图像强度变化。这些传感器特性非常适合与广播视觉通信信道协同实现视觉目标跟踪，用于分布式机器人中的智能视觉信标应用。视觉信标可通过高频调制发光二极管（LED）构建，例如车辆前照灯、物联网（IoT）LED、智能建筑灯等，这些在许多现实场景中已经存在。事件相机的高时间分辨率特性使其能够以远高于经典帧相机的数据速率捕获视觉信号。在本文中，我们提出一种新颖的智能视觉信标架构，包含LED调制和事件相机解调算法。我们定量评估了所原型化的智能视觉信标通信系统中LED传输速率、通信距离与消息传输精度之间的关系。所提方法在室内环境中实现最高4 kbps，并在全日照下以500 bps的传输速率实现100米距离上的无损传输，展示了该技术在室外环境中的潜力。

items.title_en: E-VLC: A Real-World Dataset for Event-based Visible Light Communication And Localization
items.abstract_en: Optical communication using modulated LEDs (e.g., visible light communication) is an emerging application for event cameras, thanks to their high spatio-temporal resolutions. Event cameras can be used simply to decode the LED signals and also to localize the camera relative to the LED marker positions. However, there is no public dataset to benchmark the decoding and localization in various real-world settings. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first public dataset that consists of an event camera, a frame camera, and ground-truth poses that are precisely synchronized with hardware triggers. It provides various camera motions with various sensitivities in different scene brightness settings, both indoor and outdoor. Furthermore, we propose a novel method of localization that leverages the Contrast Maximization framework for motion estimation and compensation. The detailed analysis and experimental results demonstrate the advantages of LED-based localization with events over the conventional AR-marker--based one with frames, as well as the efficacy of the proposed method in localization. We hope that the proposed dataset serves as a future benchmark for both motion-related classical computer vision tasks and LED marker decoding tasks simultaneously, paving the way to broadening applications of event cameras on mobile devices. https://woven-visionai.github.io/evlc-dataset
items.title_zh: E-VLC：用于基于事件的可见光通信与定位的真实世界数据集
items.abstract_zh: 使用调制LED的光通信（例如可见光通信）是事件相机的一项新兴应用，这得益于其高时空分辨率。事件相机可简单地用于解码LED信号，也可用于相对于LED标记位置定位相机。然而，尚无公开数据集用于在各种真实世界设置中对解码和定位进行基准测试。据我们所知，我们提出了首个公开数据集，它由事件相机、帧相机以及与硬件触发精确同步的真值位姿组成。该数据集提供了在不同场景亮度设置（室内和室外）下具有不同灵敏度的多种相机运动。此外，我们提出一种新的定位方法，利用对比度最大化框架进行运动估计和补偿。详细分析和实验结果表明，基于事件的LED定位优于基于帧的传统AR标记定位，也证明了所提方法在定位中的有效性。我们希望所提数据集能够同时作为运动相关经典计算机视觉任务和LED标记解码任务的未来基准，为拓宽事件相机在移动设备上的应用铺平道路。https://woven-visionai.github.io/evlc-dataset

items.title_en: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
items.title_zh: VisionSIM：超越理想化传感器——面向机器人感知的多模态仿真器
items.abstract_en: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人感知日益依赖异构传感器套件，将相机与新兴模态（事件、SPAD、iToF/dToF和热成像）相结合。然而，现有仿真器将这些传感器理想化，掩盖了限制现实世界部署的关键模态特定失效模式。我们提出VisionSIM，一个统一的、基于物理的仿真平台，通过对多种传统和新兴模态的原始物理测量过程建模，将传感器真实性提升为首要关注点。我们提供对物理传感器参数的细粒度控制，复现通用仿真器忽略的失效模式：LiDAR的堆积和眩光；iToF的相位卷绕、饱和与运动伪影；事件相机的不应期丢事件；以及热成像相机的历史相关发射。这使得能够在相同场景和轨迹上进行有原则的跨模态比较。我们发布该平台以及一个大型室内数据集，包含同步的原始测量和丰富的真值标注。

items.title_en: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
items.title_zh: PrimeSim：基于大规模跨具身演示的通用世界模型模拟器
items.abstract_en: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.
items.abstract_zh: 作为模拟器的机器人世界模型不能仅生成看似合理的视频：它必须忠实跟随指令动作、保持跨相机视图的一致性，并维持连贯的长时程推演。我们提出PrimeSim，一种动作条件下的多视图世界模型模拟器，通过渐进式中间训练和后训练来应对这些挑战。从预训练视频生成器出发，我们在涵盖22个平台的30,110小时机器人演示上进行中间训练。为改善动作跟随，我们引入统一的跨具身动作表示和帧对齐双路径条件化，以增强动作与帧的对应关系。为保持多视图一致性，我们开发了带有显式相机身份的视图感知交错注意力，在保留视图特定表示的同时实现跨视图信息交换。我们进一步引入快视频、慢记忆的后训练框架，将双向视频生成器转变为高效的自回归模拟器。通过结合快速因果生成、自推演训练和分层时间记忆，PrimeSim缓解了来自自生成历史的误差累积，并支持连贯的长时程模拟。PrimeSim以10.1 FPS运行，在刚性和可变形操作任务的长时程推演中保持稳定，并能在100到200个梯度步内迁移到留出平台，而预训练骨干无法做到。与五个开源动作条件世界模型相比，它在五个WorldSimProbe套件中的四个上领先，并取得最佳的EWMBench总体得分，而细粒度局部校准仍落后于该领域；其推演足够忠实，可支持基于GRPO的策略优化。我们发布模型权重、推理代码和训练代码。
